verses.1:1: Blessed is the man who has not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, and has not stood in the way of sinners, and has not sat upon the seat of pestilent men;
verses.1:2: but rather his desire is in the law of the Lord, and in His law he shall meditate day and night.
verses.1:3: And he shall be like the tree planted beside the channels of waters, which shall yield its fruit in its season, and its leaf shall not fall away; and all that he may do shall prosper.
verses.1:4: Not so are the ungodly, not so; but rather they are like the dust that the wind scatters from the face of the earth.
verses.1:5: Therefore the ungodly shall not rise up in judgment, nor sinners in the counsel of the righteous;
verses.1:6: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.2:1: Why did the nations rage, and the peoples meditate upon vain things?
verses.2:2: The kings of the earth took their stand, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against His Anointed. Interlude.
verses.2:3: "Let us burst Their bonds apart, and cast away Their yoke from us."
verses.2:4: He who dwells in the heavens shall laugh at them, and the Lord shall deride them.
verses.2:5: Then He shall speak to them in His wrath, and in His fury He shall dismay them.
verses.2:6: Yet I was appointed by Him upon Zion, His holy mountain,
verses.2:7: proclaiming the decree of the Lord. The Lord said to Me, "You are My Son; this day I have begotten You.
verses.2:8: Ask of Me, and I shall give You nations for Your inheritance, and as Your possession the ends of the earth.
verses.2:9: You shall shepherd them with an iron rod; like a potter's vessel You shall shatter them."
verses.2:10: And now, O kings, understand; be instructed, all you who judge the earth.
verses.2:11: Serve the Lord in fear, and rejoice in Him with trembling.
verses.2:12: Lay hold of instruction, lest the Lord become angry and you perish from the righteous way, when His fury is swiftly kindled. Blessed are all who trust in Him.
verses.3:1: A psalm of David, when he fled from the face of Absalom his son.
verses.3:2: O Lord, why have those who afflict me been multiplied? Many are rising up against me;
verses.3:3: many say to my soul, "There is no salvation in his God." Interlude.
verses.3:4: But You, O Lord, are my protector, my glory, and the One who lifts up my head.
verses.3:5: With my voice I cried aloud to the Lord, and He heard me from His holy mountain. Interlude.
verses.3:6: I lay down and fell asleep; I awoke, for the Lord will uphold me.
verses.3:7: I shall not fear ten thousands of people who assail me on every side.
verses.3:8: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God! For You have struck all who are hostile to me without cause; You have shattered the teeth of sinners.
verses.3:9: To the Lord belongs salvation, and upon Your people is Your blessing.
verses.4:1: For the end, in psalms; a song of David.
verses.4:2: When I called, the God of my righteousness heard me; in distress You made room for me. Have compassion on me, and hear my prayer.
verses.4:3: O sons of men, how long will you be heavy of heart? Why do you love vanity and seek falsehood? Interlude.
verses.4:4: And know that the Lord has made His holy one wondrous; the Lord will hear me when I cry out to Him.
verses.4:5: Be angry, and do not sin; for the things you speak in your heart, feel compunction upon your beds. Interlude.
verses.4:6: Offer a sacrifice of righteousness, and hope in the Lord.
verses.4:7: Many say, "Who will show us good things?" The light of Your countenance has been marked upon us, O Lord.
verses.4:8: You have put gladness into my heart; from the fruit of their wheat and wine and oil they have been multiplied.
verses.4:9: In peace I will at once lie down and sleep; for You alone, O Lord, have made me dwell in hope.
verses.5:1: For the end, concerning her who inherits; a psalm of David.
verses.5:2: Give ear to my words, O Lord; understand my cry.
verses.5:3: Give heed to the voice of my supplication, my King and my God; for to You I will pray, O Lord.
verses.5:4: In the morning You shall hear my voice; in the morning I will stand before You and watch.
verses.5:5: For You are not a God who desires lawlessness, nor shall an evildoer sojourn with You.
verses.5:6: Transgressors shall not abide before Your eyes; You have hated, O Lord, all who work iniquity.
verses.5:7: You shall destroy all who speak falsehood; the Lord abhors a man of bloodshed and deceit.
verses.5:8: But as for me, in the multitude of Your mercy I will enter into Your house; I will worship toward Your holy temple in fear of You.
verses.5:9: O Lord, guide me in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make my way straight before You.
verses.5:10: For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they have dealt deceitfully.
verses.5:11: Judge them, O God; let them fall away from their counsels. According to the multitude of their impieties cast them out, for they have provoked You to bitterness, O Lord.
verses.5:12: And let all who hope in You be glad in You; forever they shall exult, and You shall dwell among them. And all who love Your name shall glory in You,
verses.5:13: for You bless the righteous. O Lord, as with a shield of favor You have crowned us.
verses.6:1: For the end, in hymns, concerning the eighth; a psalm of David.
verses.6:2: O Lord, do not reprove me in Your wrath, nor chasten me in Your anger.
verses.6:3: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak; heal me, for my bones are troubled.
verses.6:4: And my soul is exceedingly troubled; and You, O Lord—how long?
verses.6:5: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul; save me for the sake of Your mercy.
verses.6:6: For in death there is no one who remembers You; and in Hades who will give thanks to You?
verses.6:7: I have grown weary in my groaning; every night I will wash my bed; with my tears I will drench my couch.
verses.6:8: My eye is troubled because of wrath; I have grown old among all my enemies.
verses.6:9: Depart from me, all you who work lawlessness, for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.6:10: The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord has received my prayer.
verses.6:11: Let all my enemies be put to shame and be exceedingly troubled; let them turn back and be put to shame exceedingly and swiftly.
verses.7:1: A psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Chusi, the son of Jemini.
verses.7:2: O Lord my God, in You I have put my hope; save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
verses.7:3: lest he snatch away my soul like a lion, while there is no one to redeem or to save.
verses.7:4: O Lord my God, if I have done this, if there is unrighteousness in my hands,
verses.7:5: if I have repaid evil to those who repay me evil, then indeed let me fall away empty from my enemies;
verses.7:6: then let the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, and trample my life down to the earth, and make my glory dwell in the dust. Interlude.
verses.7:7: Arise, O Lord, in Your wrath; be exalted in the borders of my enemies; awake, O Lord my God, in the decree which You have commanded.
verses.7:8: And the assembly of peoples shall surround You; and above it, return on high.
verses.7:9: The Lord shall judge the peoples; judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness and according to my innocence that is upon me.
verses.7:10: Let the wickedness of sinners come to an end, and You shall guide the righteous straight; God examines hearts and inward parts.
verses.7:11: Righteous is my help from God, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.7:12: God is a righteous Judge, strong and longsuffering, not bringing wrath every day.
verses.7:13: If you do not turn back, He will burnish His sword; He has bent His bow and made it ready;
verses.7:14: and with it He has prepared weapons of death; He has fashioned His arrows for those who burn.
verses.7:15: Behold, he travailed with lawlessness; he conceived trouble and brought forth unrighteousness.
verses.7:16: He dug a pit and hollowed it out, and he shall fall into the ditch which he has made.
verses.7:17: His trouble shall return upon his own head, and upon the crown of his head his unrighteousness shall descend.
verses.7:18: I will give thanks to the Lord according to His righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.8:1: For the end, concerning the winepresses; a psalm of David.
verses.8:2: O Lord, our Lord, how wondrous is Your name in all the earth! For Your magnificence has been lifted up above the heavens.
verses.8:3: From the mouth of infants and nursing babes You have prepared praise because of Your enemies, to overthrow the enemy and the avenger.
verses.8:4: For I will behold the heavens, the works of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have founded;
verses.8:5: what is man that You remember him, or a son of man that You watch over him?
verses.8:6: You made him a little lower than the angels; with glory and honor You crowned him.
verses.8:7: And You set him over the works of Your hands; all things You subjected beneath his feet,
verses.8:8: sheep and all cattle, and moreover the beasts of the field,
verses.8:9: the birds of heaven and the fish of the sea, those that pass through the paths of the seas.
verses.8:10: O Lord, our Lord, how wondrous is Your name in all the earth!
verses.9:1: For the end, concerning the hidden things of the son; a psalm of David.
verses.9:2: I will give thanks to You, O Lord, with all my heart; I will recount all Your wondrous works.
verses.9:3: I will be glad and exult in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
verses.9:4: When my enemy is turned back, they shall falter and perish from before Your presence.
verses.9:5: For You have executed my judgment and my cause; You sat upon a throne, judging righteousness.
verses.9:6: You have rebuked the nations, and the ungodly has perished; You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.9:7: The swords of the enemy have utterly failed, and You have torn down cities; their memorial has perished with a resounding noise;
verses.9:8: and the Lord abides forever; He has prepared His throne in judgment.
verses.9:9: And He Himself shall judge the inhabited world in righteousness; He shall judge the peoples in uprightness.
verses.9:10: And the Lord has become a refuge for the needy, a helper in due seasons, in affliction.
verses.9:11: And let those who know Your name put their hope in You, for You have not forsaken those who seek You out, O Lord.
verses.9:12: Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
verses.9:13: For He who requires their blood has remembered; He has not forgotten the supplication of the needy.
verses.9:14: Have mercy on me, O Lord; behold my humiliation from my enemies, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.9:15: so that I may declare all Your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion; I will exult in Your salvation.
verses.9:16: The nations have been caught fast in the destruction which they made; in this snare which they hid, their foot has been seized.
verses.9:17: The Lord is known as executing judgments; in the works of his own hands the sinner has been caught. A song of interlude.
verses.9:18: Let sinners be turned back to Hades, all the nations that forget God.
verses.9:19: For the poor shall not be forgotten to the end; the patient endurance of the needy shall not perish forever.
verses.9:20: Arise, O Lord; do not let man grow strong; let the nations be judged before You.
verses.9:21: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them; let the nations know that they are men. Interlude.
verses.9:22: Why, O Lord, do You stand far off? Do You look away in due seasons, in affliction?
verses.9:23: While the ungodly acts arrogantly, the poor is consumed with fire; they are caught in the schemes which they devise.
verses.9:24: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul, and the one who does unrighteousness is blessed.
verses.9:25: The sinner has provoked the Lord; according to the abundance of his wrath he will not inquire; God is not before him.
verses.9:26: His ways are profaned at all times; Your judgments are taken away from before his face; he shall rule over all his enemies.
verses.9:27: For he said in his heart, "I shall by no means be shaken, from generation to generation, without evil."
verses.9:28: His mouth is full of cursing and bitterness and deceit; beneath his tongue are toil and trouble.
verses.9:29: He sits in ambush with the rich in secret places to slay the innocent; his eyes look intently toward the needy.
verses.9:30: He lies in ambush in a secret place, like a lion in his den; he lies in ambush to seize the poor, to seize the poor as he draws him in; in his snare
verses.9:31: he will bring him low; he will stoop and fall when he gains dominion over the needy.
verses.9:32: For he said in his heart, "God has forgotten; He has turned away His face so as not to see to the end."
verses.9:33: Arise, O Lord God; let Your hand be lifted up; do not forget the needy.
verses.9:34: Why has the ungodly provoked God? For he said in his heart, "He will not inquire."
verses.9:35: You see, for You shall regard trouble and fury, to deliver them into Your hands. To You, therefore, the poor has been left; to the orphan You have been a helper.
verses.9:36: Break the arm of the sinner and wicked man; his sin shall be sought out, and he shall by no means be found because of it.
verses.9:37: The Lord shall reign forever and ever; you shall perish, O nations, from His land.
verses.9:38: The Lord has heard the desire of the needy; Your ear has attended to the readiness of their heart,
verses.9:39: to render justice for the orphan and the humble, so that man upon the earth may no longer boast arrogantly.
verses.10:1: For the end; a psalm of David. In the Lord I have put my trust; how will you say to my soul, "Flee to the mountains like a sparrow"?
verses.10:2: For behold, the sinners have bent a bow, they have made ready arrows in a quiver, to shoot down in a moonless night the upright in heart.
verses.10:3: For the things You have established, they have torn down; and what has the righteous one done?
verses.10:4: The Lord is in His holy temple; the Lord—His throne is in heaven. His eyes look upon the poor; His eyelids examine the sons of men.
verses.10:5: The Lord examines the righteous and the ungodly; but he who loves unrighteousness hates his own soul.
verses.10:6: He shall rain snares upon sinners; fire and brimstone and a tempestuous wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.10:7: For the Lord is righteous, and He has loved righteous deeds; His countenance has beheld uprightness.
verses.11:1: For the end, concerning the eighth; a psalm of David.
verses.11:2: Save me, O Lord, for the godly one has failed, for truths have diminished from among the sons of men.
verses.11:3: Each one has spoken vain things to his neighbor; deceitful lips have spoken with a heart and a heart.
verses.11:4: May the Lord utterly destroy all deceitful lips and the boastful tongue,
verses.11:5: those who have said, "We will magnify our tongue; our lips are our own; who is lord over us?"
verses.11:6: "Because of the misery of the poor and because of the groaning of the needy, now I will arise," says the Lord; "I will set him in salvation; I will act boldly on his behalf."
verses.11:7: The oracles of the Lord are pure oracles, silver tried by fire, tested in the earth, purified sevenfold.
verses.11:8: You, O Lord, shall guard us, and You shall preserve us from this generation and forever.
verses.11:9: On every side the ungodly walk; according to Your height, You have greatly cared for the sons of men.
verses.12:2: For the end; a psalm of David. How long, O Lord, will You forget me to the end? How long will You turn Your face away from me?
verses.12:3: How long shall I lay up counsels in my soul, sorrows in my heart by day? How long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.12:4: Look, hear me, O Lord my God; enlighten my eyes, lest I ever fall asleep in death,
verses.12:5: lest my enemy ever say, "I have prevailed against him"; those who afflict me will exult if I am shaken. But I have hoped in Your mercy; my heart shall exult in Your salvation;
verses.12:6: I will sing to the Lord, who has done good to me, and I will sing psalms to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.13:1: For the end; a psalm of David. A foolish man has said in his heart, "There is no God." They have become corrupt and abominable in their practices; there is no one who does good, there is not even one.
verses.13:2: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands or who earnestly seeks God.
verses.13:3: All have turned aside; together they have become worthless; there is no one who does good, there is not even one. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they have practiced deceit; the venom of asps is beneath their lips, whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness. Their feet are swift to shed blood; ruin and wretchedness are in their ways, and they have not known the way of peace. There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.13:4: Will all who work unrighteousness not come to know, who devour My people as they eat bread? They have not called upon the Lord.
verses.13:5: There they trembled with fear where there was no fear, for God is in a righteous generation.
verses.13:6: You have put to shame the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his hope.
verses.13:7: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back the captivity of His people, let Jacob exult and let Israel be glad.
verses.14:1: A psalm of David. O Lord, who shall sojourn in Your tabernacle, and who shall dwell on Your holy mountain?
verses.14:2: He who walks blamelessly and practices righteousness, speaking truth in his heart;
verses.14:3: who has not dealt deceitfully with his tongue, nor done evil to his neighbor, and has not taken up a reproach against those nearest to him;
verses.14:4: in his sight an evildoer is despised, yet he honors those who fear the Lord; he who swears to his neighbor and does not break faith;
verses.14:5: he has not lent his silver at interest, and he has not accepted bribes against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
verses.15:1: A pillar inscription of David. Guard me, O Lord, for I have put my hope in You.
verses.15:2: I said to the Lord, "You are my Lord."
verses.15:3: For the saints who are in His land, He has made wondrous all His desires in them.
verses.15:4: Their infirmities were multiplied; after these things they hastened. I will by no means gather their assemblies of blood, nor will I ever make mention of their names through my lips.
verses.15:5: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup; You are the One who restores my inheritance to me.
verses.15:6: Measuring lines have fallen to me in the finest places; for indeed my inheritance is finest to me.
verses.15:7: I will bless the Lord, who has given me understanding; moreover, even until night my inward parts have instructed me.
verses.15:8: I continually beheld the Lord before me, because He is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.
verses.15:9: For this reason my heart was glad and my tongue exulted; furthermore, my flesh also shall dwell in hope.
verses.15:10: For You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You permit Your Holy One to see decay.
verses.15:11: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with gladness before Your countenance; delights are in Your right hand to the end.
verses.16:1: A Prayer of David. Hear my righteousness, O Lord; attend to my supplication. Give ear to my prayer, not from deceitful lips.
verses.16:2: Let my judgment proceed from Your presence; let my eyes behold uprightness.
verses.16:3: You have tested my heart; You have visited me in the night; You have tried me with fire, and no unrighteousness was found in me.
verses.16:4: So that my mouth may not speak of the works of men, because of the words of Your lips I have kept hard ways.
verses.16:5: Establish my steps in Your paths, so that my steps may not be shaken.
verses.16:6: I have cried aloud, for You have heard me, O God; incline Your ear to me, and hear my words.
verses.16:7: Make wondrous Your mercies, O You who save those who hope in You from those who resist Your right hand.
verses.16:8: Guard me as the pupil of the eye; in the shelter of Your wings You shall cover me
verses.16:9: from the face of the ungodly who have afflicted me. My enemies have encompassed my soul;
verses.16:10: they have closed up their fat; their mouth has spoken arrogance.
verses.16:11: Casting me out, they have now encircled me; they have set their eyes to bend down to the earth.
verses.16:12: They lay in wait for me like a lion ready for prey, and like a young lion dwelling in secret places.
verses.16:13: Arise, O Lord, confront them and overthrow them; deliver my soul from the ungodly, Your sword
verses.16:14: from the enemies of Your hand. O Lord, dismissing them from the earth, divide them in their life; and their belly has been filled with Your hidden things; they have been satisfied with swine's flesh, and they have left the remnants to their infants.
verses.16:15: But as for me, in righteousness I shall appear before Your face; I shall be satisfied when Your glory appears.
verses.17:1: For the end; for David, the servant of the Lord, the words of this song which he spoke to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
verses.17:2: And he said, "I will love You, O Lord, my strength.
verses.17:3: The Lord is my firmament and my refuge and my deliverer; my God is a helper, and I will hope in Him; my protector and the horn of salvation, my upholder.
verses.17:4: Praising, I will call upon the Lord, and I shall be saved from my enemies.
verses.17:5: The pangs of death encompassed me, and the torrents of lawlessness terrified me;
verses.17:6: the pangs of Hades encircled me; the snares of death confronted me.
verses.17:7: And in my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried aloud to my God; He heard my voice from His holy temple, and my cry before Him shall enter into His ears.
verses.17:8: And the earth was shaken and trembled, and the foundations of the mountains were troubled and shaken, because God was angry with them.
verses.17:9: Smoke went up in His wrath, and fire blazed forth before Him; coals were kindled from Him.
verses.17:10: And He bowed heaven and descended, and thick darkness was under His feet.
verses.17:11: And He mounted upon the cherubim and flew; He flew upon the wings of the winds.
verses.17:12: And He made darkness His hiding place; all around Him was His tent, dark water in the clouds of the air.
verses.17:13: From the radiance before Him the clouds passed through—hail and coals of fire.
verses.17:14: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High uttered His voice;
verses.17:15: and He sent forth arrows and scattered them, and He multiplied lightnings and confounded them.
verses.17:16: And the springs of the waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at Your rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of Your wrath.
verses.17:17: He sent from on high and took hold of me; He drew me to Himself out of many waters.
verses.17:18: He will deliver me from my mighty enemies and from those who hate me, for they became stronger than I.
verses.17:19: They confronted me in the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my support,
verses.17:20: and He brought me out into a broad place; He will deliver me, because He delighted in me.
verses.17:21: He will deliver me from my mighty enemies and from those who hate me. And the Lord will recompense me according to my righteousness, and according to the cleanness of my hands He will recompense me.
verses.17:22: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not acted ungodly in departing from my God;
verses.17:23: for all His judgments are before me, and His ordinances did not depart from me.
verses.17:24: And I shall be blameless with Him, and I shall keep myself from my iniquity.
verses.17:25: And the Lord will recompense me according to my righteousness, and according to the cleanness of my hands before His eyes.
verses.17:26: With the holy You will show Yourself holy, and with an innocent man You will be innocent;
verses.17:27: and with the chosen You will be chosen, and with the perverse You will deal perversely.
verses.17:28: For You will save a humble people, and You will bring low the eyes of the proud;
verses.17:29: for You will light my lamp, O Lord; my God, You will illumine my darkness.
verses.17:30: For by You I shall be delivered from a marauding band, and by my God I shall scale a wall.
verses.17:31: As for my God, His way is blameless; the oracles of the Lord are tried by fire; He is a protector of all who hope in Him.
verses.17:32: For who is God except the Lord? And who is God except our God?
verses.17:33: It is God who girds me with strength, and He has made my way blameless;
verses.17:34: who makes my feet like those of a deer, and sets me upon the high places;
verses.17:35: who teaches my hands for battle, and You have made my arms a bow of bronze.
verses.17:36: And You have given me the protection of my salvation, and Your right hand has upheld me; and Your discipline has set me upright to the end, and Your discipline itself shall teach me.
verses.17:37: You have widened my steps beneath me, and my footsteps have not grown weak.
verses.17:38: I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until they fail;
verses.17:39: I will crush them, and they shall by no means be able to stand; they shall fall beneath my feet.
verses.17:40: And You have girded me with strength for battle; You have shackled beneath me all who rise up against me.
verses.17:41: And You have made my enemies turn their back to me, and those who hate me You have utterly destroyed.
verses.17:42: They cried aloud, and there was none to save; to the Lord, and He did not hear them.
verses.17:43: And I will grind them fine like dust before the face of the wind; like mire of the streets I will trample them smooth.
verses.17:44: Deliver me from the contentions of the people; You shall set me as head of the nations; a people whom I did not know served me,
verses.17:45: at the hearing of the ear they obeyed me; foreign sons lied to me;
verses.17:46: foreign sons grew old and went limping from their paths.
verses.17:47: The Lord lives, and blessed be my God, and let the God of my salvation be exalted—
verses.17:48: the God who gives vengeance to me, and has subdued peoples under me,
verses.17:49: my deliverer from wrathful enemies. From those who rise up against me You shall exalt me; from an unrighteous man You shall deliver me.
verses.17:50: Therefore I will give thanks to You among the nations, O Lord, and to Your name I will sing praises,
verses.17:51: magnifying the deliverances of His king, and showing mercy to His anointed, to David and to his seed forever."
verses.18:1: For the end: a psalm of David.
verses.18:2: The heavens recount the glory of God, and the firmament announces the work of His hands.
verses.18:3: Day to day pours forth speech, and night to night announces knowledge.
verses.18:4: There are no utterances nor words whose voices are not heard;
verses.18:5: Into all the earth their sound has gone forth, and their words to the ends of the inhabited world.
verses.18:6: In the sun He has set His tabernacle; and he, like a bridegroom coming forth from his bridal chamber, shall exult like a giant to run his course.
verses.18:7: From the extremity of heaven is his going forth, and his goal reaches to the extremity of heaven; and there is none who shall be hidden from his heat.
verses.18:8: The law of the Lord is blameless, restoring souls; the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to babes.
verses.18:9: The ordinances of the Lord are upright, gladdening the heart; the commandment of the Lord is radiant, giving light to the eyes.
verses.18:10: The fear of the Lord is pure, abiding forever and ever; the judgments of the Lord are true, justified altogether,
verses.18:11: more desirable than gold and much precious stone, and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.18:12: For indeed Your servant keeps them; in keeping them there is great recompense.
verses.18:13: Who shall understand offenses? Cleanse me from my hidden faults,
verses.18:14: and spare Your servant from strangers; if they do not gain dominion over me, then I shall be blameless, and I shall be cleansed from great sin.
verses.18:15: And the utterances of my mouth and the meditation of my heart shall be well-pleasing before You continually, O Lord, my Helper and my Redeemer.
verses.19:1: For the end: a psalm of David.
verses.19:2: May the Lord hear you in the day of affliction; may the name of the God of Jacob shield you.
verses.19:3: May He send forth help to you from the sanctuary, and out of Zion may He uphold you.
verses.19:4: May He remember every sacrifice of yours, and let Him make your whole burnt offering fat. Interlude.
verses.19:5: May He grant you according to your heart, and fulfill all your counsel.
verses.19:6: Let us exult in your salvation, and in the name of our God we shall be magnified. May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.
verses.19:7: Now I know that the Lord has saved His anointed; He shall hear him from His holy heaven; in mighty deeds is the salvation of His right hand.
verses.19:8: Some in chariots and some in horses, but we shall be magnified in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.19:9: They were fettered and fell, but we rose and were set upright.
verses.19:10: O Lord, save Your king, and hear us in whatever day we call upon You.
verses.20:1: For the end: a psalm of David.
verses.20:2: O Lord, in Your strength the king shall be glad, and in Your salvation he shall exult exceedingly.
verses.20:3: You have given him the desire of his soul, and You have not deprived him of the supplication of his lips. Interlude.
verses.20:4: For You went before him with blessings of goodness; You placed upon his head a crown of precious stone.
verses.20:5: He asked life of You, and You gave it to him—length of days forever and ever.
verses.20:6: Great is his glory in Your salvation; glory and majesty You shall lay upon him;
verses.20:7: for You shall give him blessing forever and ever; You shall gladden him in joy with Your countenance.
verses.20:8: For the king hopes in the Lord, and in the mercy of the Most High he shall never be shaken.
verses.20:9: May Your hand be found upon all Your enemies; may Your right hand find all who hate You.
verses.20:10: You shall make them like a furnace of fire at the time of Your countenance; O Lord, in Your wrath You shall confound them, and fire shall devour them.
verses.20:11: Their fruit You shall destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the sons of men.
verses.20:12: For they turned evil things against You; they devised a counsel which they shall by no means be able to establish.
verses.20:13: For You shall make them turn their back; among Your remnants You shall prepare their face.
verses.20:14: Be exalted, O Lord, in Your strength; we shall sing and chant Your mighty deeds.
verses.21:1: For the end, concerning the morning help: a psalm of David.
verses.21:2: O God, my God, give heed to me; why have You forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my transgressions.
verses.21:3: O my God, I will cry out by day to You, and You will not hear; and by night, and it is not to my folly.
verses.21:4: Yet You dwell among the holy ones, O praise of Israel.
verses.21:5: In You our fathers hoped; they hoped, and You delivered them.
verses.21:6: To You they cried out and were saved; in You they hoped and were not put to shame.
verses.21:7: But I am a worm and not a man, a reproach of man and the scorn of the people.
verses.21:8: All who look upon me have mocked me; they spoke with their lips, they shook their head:
verses.21:9: "He hoped in the Lord; let Him deliver him; let Him save him, because He delights in him."
verses.21:10: For You are the One who drew me forth from the womb, my hope from the breasts of my mother.
verses.21:11: Upon You I was cast from the womb; from my mother's belly You are my God.
verses.21:12: Do not depart from me, for affliction is near, for there is none to help.
verses.21:13: Many young bulls have encircled me; fat bulls have hemmed me in.
verses.21:14: They opened their mouth against me, like a ravenous and roaring lion.
verses.21:15: Like water I was poured out, and all my bones were scattered; my heart became like wax melting in the midst of my belly.
verses.21:16: My strength dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue clings to my throat; and into the dust of death You have brought me down.
verses.21:17: For many dogs have surrounded me; an assembly of evildoers has enclosed me; they pierced my hands and feet.
verses.21:18: They numbered all my bones; and they themselves observed and looked upon me.
verses.21:19: They divided my garments among themselves, and upon my apparel they cast a lot.
verses.21:20: But You, O Lord, do not put my help far away; attend to my aid.
verses.21:21: Deliver my soul from the sword, and my only one from the hand of the dog.
verses.21:22: Save me from the mouth of the lion, and my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.21:23: I will declare Your name to my brethren; in the midst of the assembly I will sing hymns to You.
verses.21:24: You who fear the Lord, praise Him; all the seed of Jacob, glorify Him; let all the seed of Israel fear Him.
verses.21:25: For He has neither despised nor disdained the supplication of the poor, nor has He turned His face away from me; and when I cried out to Him, He heard me.
verses.21:26: From You comes my praise in the great assembly; my vows I will fulfill before those who fear Him.
verses.21:27: The needy shall eat and be filled, and those who diligently seek Him shall praise the Lord; their hearts shall live forever and ever.
verses.21:28: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn back to the Lord, and all the families of the nations shall worship before Him;
verses.21:29: for the kingdom is the Lord's, and He Himself exercises dominion over the nations.
verses.21:30: All the prosperous of the earth ate and worshiped; before Him shall fall down all who descend into the earth; and my soul lives for Him.
verses.21:31: And my seed shall serve Him; the coming generation shall be proclaimed to the Lord,
verses.21:32: and they shall proclaim His righteousness to a people yet to be born, whom the Lord has made.
verses.22:1: A Psalm for David. The Lord shepherds me, and nothing shall cause me to want.
verses.22:2: In a place of tender grass, there He made me dwell; beside water of rest He nurtured me;
verses.22:3: He restored my soul. He guided me along paths of righteousness for His name's sake.
verses.22:4: For even though I walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will fear no evils, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they have comforted me.
verses.22:5: You have prepared before me a table in the presence of those who afflict me; You have anointed my head with oil, and Your cup is intoxicating as the choicest.
verses.22:6: And Your mercy shall pursue me all the days of my life, and my dwelling shall be in the house of the Lord for length of days.
verses.23:1: A psalm of David, for the first day of the week. To the Lord belongs the earth and its fullness, the inhabited world and all who dwell in it.
verses.23:2: He Himself founded it upon the seas, and upon the rivers He prepared it.
verses.23:3: Who shall ascend the mountain of the Lord, and who shall stand in His holy place?
verses.23:4: He who is innocent in hands and pure in heart, who has not received his soul in vain, and has not sworn with deceit to his neighbor.
verses.23:5: This man shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Savior.
verses.23:6: This is the generation of those who seek Him, of those who seek the face of the God of Jacob. Interlude.
verses.23:7: Lift up your gates, O rulers, and be lifted up, O everlasting gates, and the King of glory shall enter in.
verses.23:8: Who is this, the King of glory? The Lord, strong and powerful; the Lord, powerful in war.
verses.23:9: Lift up your gates, O rulers, and be lifted up, O everlasting gates, and the King of glory shall enter in.
verses.23:10: Who is this, the King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He Himself is this King of glory.
verses.24:1: A psalm of David. To You, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul,
verses.24:2: O my God; in You I have trusted; may I not be put to shame, nor let my enemies laugh at me.
verses.24:3: For indeed, all who wait patiently for You shall by no means be put to shame; let those be ashamed who practice lawlessness in vain.
verses.24:4: Make Your ways known to me, O Lord, and teach me Your paths.
verses.24:5: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are God my Savior, and for You I have waited all the day long.
verses.24:6: Remember Your compassions and Your mercies, for they are from everlasting.
verses.24:7: Do not remember the sins of my youth and of ignorance; according to Your mercy remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, O Lord.
verses.24:8: Good and upright is the Lord; therefore He will give law to sinners in the way.
verses.24:9: He will guide the meek in judgment; He will teach the meek His ways.
verses.24:10: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth to those who diligently seek His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.24:11: For the sake of Your name, O Lord, You shall also pardon my sin, for it is great.
verses.24:12: Who is the man who fears the Lord? He will give him law in the way that he has chosen.
verses.24:13: His soul shall abide among good things, and his seed shall inherit the land.
verses.24:14: The Lord is the stronghold of those who fear Him, and the name of the Lord belongs to those who fear Him, and His covenant is to make it manifest to them.
verses.24:15: My eyes are continually toward the Lord, for He Himself shall pluck my feet out of the snare.
verses.24:16: Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am solitary and poor.
verses.24:17: The afflictions of my heart have been multiplied; bring me out of my distresses.
verses.24:18: Behold my lowliness and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
verses.24:19: Behold my enemies, for they have been multiplied, and with an unjust hatred they have hated me.
verses.24:20: Guard my soul and deliver me; may I not be put to shame, for I have hoped in You.
verses.24:21: The innocent and the upright clung to me, for I waited patiently for You, O Lord.
verses.24:22: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his afflictions.
verses.25:1: Of David. Judge me, O Lord, for I have walked in my innocence, and hoping in the Lord I shall never be shaken.
verses.25:2: Examine me, O Lord, and test me; refine with fire my inward parts and my heart.
verses.25:3: For Your mercy is before my eyes, and I have been well pleased in Your truth.
verses.25:4: I have not sat with a council of vanity, and with transgressors I shall never enter;
verses.25:5: I have hated the assembly of evildoers, and with the ungodly I shall never sit.
verses.25:6: I will wash my hands among the innocent, and I will go around Your altar,
verses.25:7: to hear the voice of praise, and to declare all Your wondrous works.
verses.25:8: O Lord, I have loved the beauty of Your house and the place of the tabernacle of Your glory.
verses.25:9: Do not destroy my soul together with the ungodly, nor my life with men of blood,
verses.25:10: in whose hands are iniquities; their right hand is filled with bribes.
verses.25:11: But as for me, I have walked in my innocence; redeem me and have mercy on me.
verses.25:12: For my foot has stood in uprightness; in the assemblies I will bless You, O Lord.
verses.26:1: Of David, before he was anointed. The Lord is my light and my Savior; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the defender of my life; of whom shall I be in dread?
verses.26:2: When evildoers drew near against me to devour my flesh, my oppressors and my enemies—they themselves grew weak and fell.
verses.26:3: Though an encampment should array itself against me, my heart shall not fear; though war should rise up against me, even in this I hope.
verses.26:4: One thing I have asked of the Lord, this I will earnestly seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the loveliness of the Lord and to visit His temple.
verses.26:5: For He hid me in a tabernacle in the day of my troubles; He sheltered me in the secret place of His tabernacle; upon a rock He lifted me high.
verses.26:6: And now, behold, He has lifted up my head above my enemies; I went around and offered in His tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation; I will sing and make melody to the Lord.
verses.26:7: "Hear, O Lord, my voice with which I have cried aloud; have mercy on me and hear me,"
verses.26:8: to You my heart has said. I have earnestly sought Your face; Your face, O Lord, I will seek.
verses.26:9: Do not turn Your face away from me; do not turn aside in wrath from Your servant. Be my helper; do not forsake me and do not overlook me, O God my Savior.
verses.26:10: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord has taken me to Himself.
verses.26:11: Appoint a law for me, O Lord, in Your way, and guide me in a straight path because of my enemies.
verses.26:12: Do not deliver me over to the desires of those who afflict me, for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and injustice has lied to itself.
verses.26:13: I will believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.26:14: Wait patiently for the Lord; be courageous, and let your heart be strengthened; and wait patiently for the Lord.
verses.27:1: Of David. To You, O Lord, I have cried aloud; O my God, do not remain silent toward me, lest You remain silent toward me and I become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.27:2: Hear the voice of my supplication when I make supplication to You, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy temple.
verses.27:3: Do not drag away my soul with sinners, nor destroy me together with those who work injustice, who speak peace with their neighbors, while evil things are in their hearts.
verses.27:4: Give to them according to their works and according to the wickedness of their practices; according to the works of their hands give to them; render to them their recompense.
verses.27:5: Because they did not understand the works of the Lord and the works of His hands, You shall tear them down and never build them up.
verses.27:6: Blessed be the Lord, for He has heard the voice of my supplication.
verses.27:7: The Lord is my helper and my defender; in Him my heart hoped, and I was helped, and my flesh blossomed anew; and of my own will I will give praise to Him.
verses.27:8: The Lord is the strength of His people, and He is the defender of the salvations of His anointed.
verses.27:9: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance, and shepherd them and lift them up forever.
verses.28:1: A Psalm of David, for the closing of the tabernacle. Bring to the Lord, O sons of God, bring to the Lord young rams; bring to the Lord glory and honor.
verses.28:2: Bring to the Lord glory to His name; worship the Lord in His holy court.
verses.28:3: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters; the God of glory has thundered, the Lord is upon many waters.
verses.28:4: The voice of the Lord is in might; the voice of the Lord is in majesty.
verses.28:5: The voice of the Lord shatters cedars; the Lord shall shatter the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.28:6: And He shall beat them small like a calf, even Lebanon, and the beloved one like the young of unicorns.
verses.28:7: The voice of the Lord cleaves a flame of fire.
verses.28:8: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shall shake the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.28:9: The voice of the Lord strengthens the deer and shall uncover the forests; and in His temple everyone declares glory.
verses.28:10: The Lord shall dwell in the flood, and the Lord shall sit as King forever.
verses.28:11: The Lord shall give strength to His people; the Lord shall bless His people in peace.
verses.29:1: To the end: a Psalm of a song for the dedication of the house, of David.
verses.29:2: I will exalt You, O Lord, for You have upheld me, and have not made my enemies rejoice over me.
verses.29:3: O Lord my God, I cried to You, and You have healed me.
verses.29:4: O Lord, You have brought my soul up out of Hades; You have saved me from those who go down into the pit.
verses.29:5: Sing praises to the Lord, His holy ones, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.29:6: For wrath is in His anger, and life is in His will; in the evening weeping shall lodge, and in the morning, exultation.
verses.29:7: And I said in my prosperity, "I shall never be shaken."
verses.29:8: O Lord, by Your will grant strength to my beauty; but You turned away Your face, and I became troubled.
verses.29:9: To You, O Lord, I will cry aloud, and to my God I will make supplication.
verses.29:10: What gain is there in my blood, when I descend into corruption? Shall dust give thanks to You, or proclaim Your truth?
verses.29:11: The Lord heard and had mercy on me; the Lord became my helper.
verses.29:12: You have turned my mourning into joy for me; You have torn off my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
verses.29:13: so that my glory may sing praises to You and I may not be pierced with sorrow. O Lord my God, forever I shall give thanks to You.
verses.30:1: To the end: a Psalm of David, of alarm.
verses.30:2: In You, O Lord, I have hoped; may I never be put to shame; in Your righteousness deliver me and rescue me.
verses.30:3: Incline Your ear to me, hasten to rescue me; be to me a defending God and a house of refuge to save me.
verses.30:4: For You are my stronghold and my refuge, and for the sake of Your name You shall guide me and nourish me.
verses.30:5: You shall bring me out of this snare which they have hidden for me, for You are my defender.
verses.30:6: Into Your hands I shall commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.
verses.30:7: You have hated those who regard vanities to no purpose, but I have hoped in the Lord.
verses.30:8: I will exult and rejoice in Your mercy, for You have looked upon my lowliness; You have saved my soul from distresses,
verses.30:9: and You have not shut me into the hands of an enemy; You have set my feet in a spacious place.
verses.30:10: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am in distress; my eye is troubled with indignation, my soul and my belly.
verses.30:11: For my life has failed in sorrow, and my years in groanings; my strength has grown weak in poverty, and my bones are troubled.
verses.30:12: Beyond all my enemies I have become a reproach, and exceedingly so to my neighbors, and a dread to my acquaintances; those who saw me outside fled from me.
verses.30:13: I have been forgotten like a dead man from the heart; I have become like a lost vessel.
verses.30:14: For I have heard the reproach of many dwelling all around; while they gathered together against me, they conspired to take my life.
verses.30:15: But I have hoped in You, O Lord; I said, "You are my God."
verses.30:16: My lots are in Your hands; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from those who pursue me.
verses.30:17: Cause Your face to shine upon Your servant; save me in Your mercy.
verses.30:18: O Lord, may I not be put to shame, for I have called upon You; let the ungodly be shamed and brought down to Hades.
verses.30:19: Let the deceitful lips become mute, which speak lawlessness against the righteous in pride and contempt.
verses.30:20: How great is the multitude of Your goodness, O Lord, which You have hidden for those who fear You; You have accomplished it for those who hope in You before the sons of men.
verses.30:21: You shall conceal them in the secret place of Your countenance from the turmoil of men; You shall shelter them in a tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.
verses.30:22: Blessed is the Lord, for He has made His mercy marvelous in a fortified city.
verses.30:23: And I said in my alarm, "Then I have been cast away from the sight of Your eyes." Therefore You heard, O Lord, the voice of my supplication when I cried out to You.
verses.30:24: Love the Lord, all His holy ones, for the Lord seeks out truths, and He repays those who act with excessive pride.
verses.30:25: Be courageous, and let your heart be strengthened, all you who hope in the Lord.
verses.31:1: Of understanding, for David. Blessed are those whose iniquities have been forgiven, and whose sins have been covered over.
verses.31:2: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will by no means reckon sin, nor is there deceit in his mouth.
verses.31:3: Because I kept silent, my bones grew old from my crying out all the day long.
verses.31:4: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; I was turned into misery while a thorn was driven in. Interlude.
verses.31:5: My sin I made known, and my iniquity I did not cover; I said, "I will confess my sin against myself to the Lord," and You forgave the ungodliness of my heart. Interlude.
verses.31:6: For this cause every devout one shall pray to You in a fitting time; yet in a flood of many waters, they shall not draw near to him.
verses.31:7: You are my refuge from the affliction that encompasses me; O my exultation, redeem me from those who have surrounded me. Interlude.
verses.31:8: I will give you understanding and instruct you in this way in which you shall go; I will fix My eyes upon you.
verses.31:9: Do not be like a horse and a mule, which have no understanding; with bit and bridle you must constrain their jaws—those that do not draw near to you.
verses.31:10: Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy shall encompass the one who hopes in the Lord.
verses.31:11: Be glad in the Lord and exult, you righteous; and glory, all you upright in heart.
verses.32:1: For David. Exult, you righteous, in the Lord; praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.32:2: Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre; with a ten-stringed harp make melody to Him.
verses.32:3: Sing to Him a new song; make melody skillfully with a shout of joy.
verses.32:4: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all His works are in faithfulness.
verses.32:5: He loves mercy and judgment; the earth is full of the lovingkindness of the Lord.
verses.32:6: By the word of the Lord the heavens were established, and by the breath of His mouth all their host.
verses.32:7: He gathers the waters of the sea as in a waterskin; He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.32:8: Let all the earth fear the Lord, and let all who inhabit the world tremble before Him.
verses.32:9: For He spoke, and they came into being; He commanded, and they were created.
verses.32:10: The Lord scatters the counsels of the nations; He sets aside the designs of the peoples, and sets aside the counsels of rulers.
verses.32:11: But the counsel of the Lord abides forever, the designs of His heart from generation to generation.
verses.32:12: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, a people whom He chose for Himself as an inheritance.
verses.32:13: From heaven the Lord looked down; He beheld all the sons of men.
verses.32:14: From His prepared dwelling place He looked upon all who inhabit the earth,
verses.32:15: He who fashioned their hearts one by one, He who understands all their works.
verses.32:16: A king is not saved by great might, and a giant shall not be saved by the abundance of his strength.
verses.32:17: A horse is deceptive for deliverance, and by the abundance of its strength it shall not be saved.
verses.32:18: Behold, the eyes of the Lord are upon those who fear Him, upon those who hope in His mercy,
verses.32:19: to rescue their souls from death, and to nourish them in famine.
verses.32:20: Our soul waits patiently for the Lord, for He is our helper and our protector.
verses.32:21: For in Him our heart shall be glad, and in His holy name we have hoped.
verses.32:22: Let Your mercy, O Lord, be upon us, just as we have hoped in You.
verses.33:1: For David, when he altered his countenance before Abimelech, and he sent him away, and he departed.
verses.33:2: I will bless the Lord in every season; continually shall His praise be in my mouth.
verses.33:3: In the Lord my soul shall be praised; let the meek hear and be glad.
verses.33:4: Magnify the Lord along with me, and let us lift up His name together.
verses.33:5: I sought out the Lord, and He heard me and rescued me from all my sojournings.
verses.33:6: Draw near to Him and be enlightened, and your faces shall by no means be put to shame.
verses.33:7: This poor man cried aloud, and the Lord heard him and saved him out of all his afflictions.
verses.33:8: The angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear Him and will rescue them.
verses.33:9: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who hopes in Him.
verses.33:10: Fear the Lord, all you His saints, for there is no lack for those who fear Him.
verses.33:11: The rich have become poor and have hungered, but those who seek out the Lord shall not be deprived of any good thing. Interlude.
verses.33:12: Come, children, hear me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.33:13: Who is the man who desires life, who loves to see good days?
verses.33:14: Restrain your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.33:15: Turn aside from evil and do good; seek after peace and pursue it.
verses.33:16: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are toward their supplication.
verses.33:17: But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to utterly destroy their remembrance from the earth.
verses.33:18: The righteous cried aloud, and the Lord heard them and rescued them out of all their afflictions.
verses.33:19: The Lord is near to those who are crushed in heart, and He will save the lowly in spirit.
verses.33:20: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, and out of them all He will rescue them.
verses.33:21: The Lord guards all their bones; not one of them shall be broken.
verses.33:22: The death of sinners is evil, and those who hate the righteous one shall incur guilt.
verses.33:23: The Lord will redeem the souls of His servants, and none of those who hope in Him shall by any means incur guilt.
verses.34:1: Of David. Judge, O Lord, those who wrong me; wage war against those who make war against me.
verses.34:2: Take hold of armor and shield, and rise up to my help.
verses.34:3: Pour out a sword and shut the way against those who pursue me; say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
verses.34:4: Let those who seek my soul be shamed and confounded; let those who devise evil against me be turned back and put to utter shame.
verses.34:5: Let them become like dust before the face of the wind, and let the angel of the Lord press them hard.
verses.34:6: Let their way become darkness and slipperiness, and let the angel of the Lord pursue them.
verses.34:7: For without cause they hid for me the destruction of their snare; in vain they reproached my soul.
verses.34:8: Let a snare which they do not know come upon them, and let the trap which they hid seize them; and into that very snare they shall fall.
verses.34:9: Then my soul shall exult in the Lord; it shall delight in His salvation.
verses.34:10: All my bones shall say, "O Lord, who is like You, delivering the poor from the hand of those stronger than he, and the poor and needy from those who plunder him?"
verses.34:11: Unjust witnesses rose up; they questioned me concerning things I did not know.
verses.34:12: They repaid me evil for good, and bereavement to my soul.
verses.34:13: Yet as for me, when they troubled me, I clothed myself in sackcloth, and I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer shall return to my own bosom.
verses.34:14: As toward a neighbor, as toward our brother, so I sought to please; as one mourning and downcast, so I humbled myself.
verses.34:15: Yet against me they rejoiced and were gathered together; scourges were gathered together against me, and I did not know it; they were torn apart and felt no remorse.
verses.34:16: They tested me, they derided me with derision, they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.34:17: O Lord, when will You look on? Restore my soul from their malice, my only one from the lions.
verses.34:18: I will give thanks to You, O Lord, in a great assembly; among a mighty people I will praise You.
verses.34:19: Do not let those who are wrongfully hostile to me gloat over me—those who hate me without cause and wink with their eyes.
verses.34:20: For to me they spoke words of peace, yet in wrath they plotted deceits.
verses.34:21: And they opened wide their mouth against me; they said, "Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it."
verses.34:22: You have seen it, O Lord; do not keep silent; O Lord, do not depart from me.
verses.34:23: Awake, O Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my cause.
verses.34:24: Judge me, O Lord, according to Your righteousness, O Lord my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
verses.34:25: Do not let them say in their hearts, "Aha, aha, for our soul!" and do not let them say, "We have swallowed him up."
verses.34:26: Let those who gloat over my troubles be shamed and confounded together; let those who speak boastfully against me be clothed with shame and disgrace.
verses.34:27: Let those who desire my righteousness exult and be glad, and let them say continually, "May the Lord be magnified," who desire the peace of His servant.
verses.34:28: And my tongue shall rehearse Your righteousness, and Your praise all the day long.
verses.35:1: For the end; of the servant of the Lord, David.
verses.35:2: The lawless man speaks within himself of sinning; there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.35:3: For he has acted deceitfully in his own sight, to discover his iniquity and to hate it.
verses.35:4: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit; he was unwilling to understand so as to do good.
verses.35:5: He devised iniquity upon his bed; he took his stand on every way that is not good, and he did not abhor wickedness.
verses.35:6: O Lord, Your mercy is in heaven, and Your truth reaches to the clouds.
verses.35:7: And Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; Your judgments are like a great deep. Men and beasts You shall save, O Lord,
verses.35:8: as You have multiplied Your mercy, O God; and the sons of men shall hope in the shelter of Your wings.
verses.35:9: They shall drink their fill from the fatness of Your house, and You shall give them to drink from the torrent of Your delight.
verses.35:10: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we shall see light.
verses.35:11: Extend Your mercy to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.35:12: Do not let the foot of pride come against me, and do not let the hand of sinners shake me.
verses.35:13: There all the workers of iniquity have fallen; they have been thrust out and shall by no means be able to stand.
verses.36:1: Of David. Do not be stirred to envy over those who act wickedly, nor be jealous of those who practice lawlessness;
verses.36:2: for like grass they shall swiftly dry up, and like green herbs they shall swiftly fall away.
verses.36:3: Hope in the Lord and practice goodness, and dwell in the land, and you shall be shepherded upon its wealth.
verses.36:4: Take delight in the Lord, and He shall give you the petitions of your heart.
verses.36:5: Reveal your way to the Lord and hope in Him, and He shall act;
verses.36:6: and He shall bring forth your righteousness as light, and your judgment as the noonday.
verses.36:7: Submit to the Lord and implore Him; do not be stirred to envy over the one who prospers in his life, over a man who commits transgressions.
verses.36:8: Cease from anger and forsake wrath; do not be stirred to envy so as to act wickedly.
verses.36:9: For those who act wickedly shall be utterly destroyed, but those who wait upon the Lord—they shall inherit the earth.
verses.36:10: And yet a little while, and a sinner shall surely be no more; and you shall search for his place, and you shall by no means find it.
verses.36:11: But the meek shall inherit the earth, and they shall take delight in a multitude of peace.
verses.36:12: The sinner shall watch closely for the righteous one, and he shall gnash his teeth against him;
verses.36:13: but the Lord shall laugh him to scorn, for He foresees that his day shall come.
verses.36:14: Sinners have drawn the sword, they have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to slay the upright in heart;
verses.36:15: may their sword enter into their own heart, and may their bows be shattered.
verses.36:16: Better is a little for the righteous one than the great wealth of sinners.
verses.36:17: For the arms of sinners shall be shattered, but the Lord upholds the righteous.
verses.36:18: The Lord knows the ways of the blameless, and their inheritance shall be forever;
verses.36:19: they shall not be put to shame in an evil time, and in days of famine they shall be filled.
verses.36:20: For sinners shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord, at the very moment they are glorified and exalted, vanishing like smoke, have utterly vanished.
verses.36:21: The sinner borrows and shall not repay, but the righteous one shows compassion and gives.
verses.36:22: For those who bless Him shall inherit the earth, but those who curse Him shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.36:23: By the Lord the steps of a man are directed aright, and He shall take pleasure in his way;
verses.36:24: when he falls, he shall not be dashed down, for the Lord steadies his hand.
verses.36:25: I was young, and indeed I have grown old, and I have not seen a righteous one forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.
verses.36:26: All the day he shows mercy and lends, and his seed shall be for a blessing.
verses.36:27: Turn aside from evil and do good, and dwell forever and ever.
verses.36:28: For the Lord loves justice, and He shall not forsake His holy ones; they shall be guarded forever; the blameless shall be avenged, and the seed of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.36:29: But the righteous shall inherit the earth, and they shall dwell upon it forever and ever.
verses.36:30: The mouth of a righteous one shall meditate on wisdom, and his tongue shall speak justice;
verses.36:31: the law of his God is in his heart, and his steps shall not slip.
verses.36:32: The sinner keeps watch over the righteous one, and seeks to put him to death;
verses.36:33: but the Lord shall by no means abandon him into his hands, nor shall He condemn him when he is judged against him.
verses.36:34: Wait patiently for the Lord and keep His way, and He shall exalt you to inherit the earth; when sinners are utterly destroyed, you shall see it.
verses.36:35: I saw an ungodly man exceedingly exalted, and lifting himself up like the cedars of Lebanon;
verses.36:36: and I passed by, and behold, he was no more; and I sought him, and his place was not found.
verses.36:37: Guard innocence and behold uprightness, for there is a remnant for a man of peace.
verses.36:38: But transgressors shall be utterly destroyed all together; the remnants of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.36:39: Yet the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord, and He is their defender in a time of affliction;
verses.36:40: and the Lord shall help them and deliver them; He shall rescue them from sinners and save them, because they have hoped in Him.
verses.37:1: A Psalm of David; for a remembrance concerning the Sabbath.
verses.37:2: O Lord, do not reprove me in Your wrath, nor chasten me in Your anger.
verses.37:3: For Your arrows have pierced into me, and You have laid Your hand heavily upon me;
verses.37:4: and there is no healing in my flesh because of Your anger; there is no peace in my bones because of my sins.
verses.37:5: For my iniquities have risen above my head; like a heavy burden they have weighed heavily upon me.
verses.37:6: My wounds have grown foul and festered because of my foolishness;
verses.37:7: I have been afflicted with misery and bowed down to the uttermost; all the day I walked about with a downcast countenance;
verses.37:8: for my soul has been filled with mockeries, and there is no healing in my flesh.
verses.37:9: I have been afflicted and humbled exceedingly; I roared aloud from the groaning of my heart.
verses.37:10: And before You is all my desire, and my groaning has not been hidden from You.
verses.37:11: My heart has been troubled, my strength has forsaken me, and the light of my eyes is not with me.
verses.37:12: My friends and my neighbors drew near opposite me and stood, and those nearest to me stood afar off;
verses.37:13: and those who seek my soul used violence, and those who seek evil against me spoke vanities, and all the day they meditated deceits.
verses.37:14: Yet I, like a deaf man, did not hear, and like a mute man who does not open his mouth;
verses.37:15: and I became like a man who does not hear, and who has no reproofs in his mouth.
verses.37:16: For in You I have hoped, O Lord; You shall hear, O Lord my God.
verses.37:17: For I said, "Let my enemies never gloat over me"; and when my feet were shaken, they spoke boastfully against me.
verses.37:18: For I am ready for scourges, and my pain is continually before me.
verses.37:19: For I shall declare my iniquity, and I shall be anxious over my sin.
verses.37:20: Yet my enemies live and have grown stronger than I, and those who hate me unjustly have been multiplied;
verses.37:21: those who repay evil for good slandered me, because I pursued righteousness.
verses.37:22: Do not forsake me, O Lord; O my God, do not depart from me;
verses.37:23: attend to my help, O Lord of my salvation.
verses.38:1: For the end, for Jeduthun; a song of David.
verses.38:2: I said, "I will guard my ways, that I may not sin with my tongue." I set a watch over my mouth while the sinner stood before me.
verses.38:3: I became mute and was humbled, and kept silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.
verses.38:4: My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation a fire shall be kindled; I spoke with my tongue:
verses.38:5: "Make known to me, O Lord, my end, and what the number of my days is, that I may know what I lack.
verses.38:6: Behold, You have made my days old, and my substance is as nothing before You; surely all things are vanity, every living man. Interlude.
verses.38:7: Indeed, man walks about in an image, yet in vain they are troubled; he stores up treasures, and does not know for whom he shall gather them.
verses.38:8: And now, what is my endurance? Is it not the Lord? And my substance is from You.
verses.38:9: Deliver me from all my iniquities; You have made me a reproach to the foolish.
verses.38:10: I became mute and did not open my mouth, because You are the One who made me.
verses.38:11: Remove Your scourges from me; by the strength of Your hand I have fainted.
verses.38:12: With rebukes for iniquity You have chastened man, and caused his soul to melt away like a spider; surely every man is troubled in vain. Interlude.
verses.38:13: Hear my prayer and my supplication; give ear to my tears. Do not pass by in silence, for I am a sojourner in the earth and a stranger, as all my fathers were.
verses.38:14: Spare me, that I may be refreshed before I depart and am no more."
verses.39:1: For the end; a psalm of David.
verses.39:2: Waiting patiently, I waited for the Lord, and He attended to me and heard my supplication.
verses.39:3: And He brought me up from a pit of misery and from the clay of the mire; He set my feet upon a rock and made my steps straight.
verses.39:4: And He put a new song into my mouth, a hymn to our God; many shall see and fear, and shall hope in the Lord.
verses.39:5: Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, and who has not looked upon vanities and false frenzies.
verses.39:6: Many are Your wondrous works that You have done, O Lord my God, and to Your thoughts there is no one who shall be likened; I declared and spoke of them, and they have been multiplied beyond number.
verses.39:7: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but You have prepared a body for me; whole burnt offering and offering for sin You did not require.
verses.39:8: Then I said, "Behold, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written concerning me;
verses.39:9: to do Your will, O my God, I have desired, and Your law is in the midst of my heart."
verses.39:10: I have proclaimed good tidings of righteousness in a great assembly; behold, I will by no means restrain my lips. O Lord, You have known
verses.39:11: my righteousness; I have not hidden Your truth in my heart, and I have spoken of Your salvation; I have not concealed Your mercy and Your truth from a numerous congregation.
verses.39:12: But You, O Lord, do not put Your tender mercies far from me; Your mercy and Your truth have continually upheld me.
verses.39:13: For evils of which there is no number have surrounded me; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I was not able to see; they have been multiplied beyond the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.
verses.39:14: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me; O Lord, give heed to help me.
verses.39:15: Let them be put to shame and confounded together who seek my soul to take it away; let them be turned backward and disgraced who wish evil for me.
verses.39:16: Let them immediately receive their shame who say to me, "Aha, aha!"
verses.39:17: Let all who seek You exult and be glad in You, O Lord; and let them say continually, "Let the Lord be magnified," those who continually love Your salvation.
verses.39:18: But I am poor and needy; the Lord will care for me. You are my helper and my defender; O my God, do not delay.
verses.40:1: For the end; a psalm of David.
verses.40:2: Blessed is he who is mindful of the poor and needy; in an evil day the Lord shall deliver him.
verses.40:3: May the Lord guard him and count him blessed in the earth, and may He not deliver him into the hands of his enemy.
verses.40:4: May the Lord help him upon his bed of pain; You have turned his entire bed in his sickness.
verses.40:5: I said, "O Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against You."
verses.40:6: My enemies spoke evil of me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"
verses.40:7: And if he came in to see me, he spoke in vain; his heart gathered iniquity for itself; he went outside and spoke
verses.40:8: together against me. All my enemies whispered against me; they devised evil against me;
verses.40:9: they laid down a lawless word against me: "Will he who sleeps not rise up again?"
verses.40:10: For even the man of my peace, in whom I hoped, who ate my bread, has magnified supplanting against me.
verses.40:11: But You, O Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.
verses.40:12: By this I have known that You have delighted in me, because my enemy shall by no means rejoice over me.
verses.40:13: But as for me, because of innocence You have upheld me, and You have established me before You forever.
verses.40:14: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity; so be it, so be it.
verses.41:1: For the end; for understanding, for the sons of Korah.
verses.41:2: As the deer longs for the springs of waters, so my soul longs for You, O God.
verses.41:3: My soul has thirsted for the living God; when shall I come and appear before the face of God?
verses.41:4: My tears have become bread by day and by night, while it is said to me every day, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:5: These things I remembered, and I poured out my soul upon myself; for I shall pass through in the place of a wondrous tabernacle, even to the house of God, with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving, the sound of those keeping festival.
verses.41:6: Why are you deeply sorrowful, O soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I shall give thanks to Him, the salvation of my countenance,
verses.41:7: my God. Within myself my soul has been troubled; therefore I will remember You from the land of the Jordan and of Hermoniim, from a small mountain.
verses.41:8: Deep calls upon deep at the voice of Your cataracts; all Your billows and Your waves have passed over me.
verses.41:9: By day the Lord will command His mercy, and by night He will declare it; with me is a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.41:10: I will say to God, "You are my Protector; why have You forgotten me? Why do I go about with a sorrowful countenance while my enemy afflicts me?"
verses.41:11: In the crushing of my bones, those who afflict me have reproached me, while they say to me every day, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:12: Why are you deeply sorrowful, O soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I shall give thanks to Him, the salvation of my countenance, my God.
verses.42:1: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an unholy nation; deliver me from an unjust and deceitful man.
verses.42:2: For You are God, my strength; why have You cast me off? And why do I go about with a sorrowful countenance while my enemy afflicts me?
verses.42:3: Send forth Your light and Your truth; they have guided me and brought me to Your holy mountain and to Your tabernacles.
verses.42:4: And I will go in to the altar of God, to God who gladdens my youth; I will give thanks to You, O Lord my God, upon the harp.
verses.42:5: Why are you deeply sorrowful, O soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I shall give thanks to Him, the salvation of my countenance, my God.
verses.43:1: For the end; for the sons of Korah, for understanding, a Psalm.
verses.43:2: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have declared to us the work which You performed in their days, in days of old.
verses.43:3: Your hand utterly destroyed nations, and You planted them; You afflicted peoples and cast them out.
verses.43:4: For they did not inherit the land by their sword, nor did their arm save them; but Your right hand, and Your arm, and the light of Your countenance, because You were well pleased in them.
verses.43:5: You Yourself are my King and my God, who commands the deliverances of Jacob.
verses.43:6: In You we shall gore our enemies, and in Your name we shall bring to nothing those who rise up against us.
verses.43:7: For I will not place my hope in my bow, and my sword shall not save me;
verses.43:8: for You have saved us from those who afflict us, and You have put to shame those who hate us.
verses.43:9: In God we shall be praised all day long, and in Your name we shall give thanks forever. Interlude.
verses.43:10: Yet now You have cast us off and put us to shame, and You will not go forth with our hosts.
verses.43:11: You have turned us back before our enemies, and those who hate us plundered for themselves;
verses.43:12: You have given us up like sheep for food, and among the nations You have scattered us;
verses.43:13: You sold Your people without price, and there was no abundance in their shoutings;
verses.43:14: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and a derision to those around us;
verses.43:15: You have made us a proverb among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.43:16: All day long my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.43:17: because of the voice of the reproacher and the reviler, because of the presence of the enemy and the persecutor.
verses.43:18: All these things have come upon us, yet we have not forgotten You, and we have not dealt unrighteously in Your covenant;
verses.43:19: and our heart has not turned back, yet You turned aside our paths from Your way.
verses.43:20: For You have humbled us in a place of affliction, and the shadow of death has covered us over.
verses.43:21: If we had forgotten the name of our God, and if we had stretched out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.43:22: would not God search these things out? For He Himself knows the hidden things of the heart.
verses.43:23: For on Your account we are put to death all the day long; we have been reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
verses.43:24: Awake! Why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise, and do not cast us off to the end.
verses.43:25: Why do You turn away Your face? Do You forget our poverty and our affliction?
verses.43:26: For our soul has been humbled to the dust; our belly has clung to the earth.
verses.43:27: Arise, O Lord, help us, and redeem us for the sake of Your name.
verses.44:1: For the end, concerning those who shall be changed; for the sons of Korah, for understanding; a song concerning the Beloved.
verses.44:2: My heart has poured forth a good word; I declare my works to the King; my tongue is the pen of a swift-writing scribe.
verses.44:3: Fair in beauty beyond the sons of men, grace has been poured forth upon Your lips; for this reason God has blessed You forever.
verses.44:4: Gird Your sword upon Your thigh, O Mighty One, in Your comeliness and Your beauty,
verses.44:5: and bend the bow, and prosper, and reign for the sake of truth and meekness and righteousness, and Your right hand shall guide You wondrously.
verses.44:6: Your arrows are sharpened, O Mighty One; peoples shall fall beneath You, in the heart of the enemies of the King.
verses.44:7: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; a scepter of uprightness is the scepter of Your kingdom.
verses.44:8: You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; for this reason God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of exultation beyond Your companions.
verses.44:9: Myrrh and stacte and cassia are from Your garments, from ivory palaces, out of which they have made You glad.
verses.44:10: Daughters of kings are in Your honor; the queen stood at Your right hand, arrayed in gold-woven apparel, richly embroidered.
verses.44:11: Listen, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear, and forget your people and the house of your father;
verses.44:12: for the King has desired your beauty, for He is your Lord.
verses.44:13: And the daughters of Tyre shall worship Him with gifts; the rich of the people of the earth shall supplicate your countenance.
verses.44:14: All her glory is that of the daughter of the king of Heshbon; in golden fringes she is arrayed, richly embroidered.
verses.44:15: Virgins shall be brought to the King behind her; her companions shall be brought to You;
verses.44:16: they shall be brought with gladness and exultation; they shall be led into the temple of the King.
verses.44:17: In place of Your fathers, sons have been born to You; You shall appoint them rulers over all the earth.
verses.44:18: They shall remember Your name in every generation and generation; therefore peoples shall give thanks to You forever, and forever and ever.
verses.45:1: For the end; for the sons of Korah, a psalm concerning hidden things.
verses.45:2: Our God is a refuge and strength, a helper in the tribulations that have found us exceedingly.
verses.45:3: Therefore we shall not fear when the earth is troubled, and mountains are removed into the hearts of the seas.
verses.45:4: Their waters roared and were troubled; the mountains were troubled in His might. Interlude.
verses.45:5: The rushing streams of the river make glad the city of God; the Most High has sanctified His tabernacle.
verses.45:6: God is in her midst; she shall not be shaken; God shall help her with His countenance.
