verses.45:7: Nations were troubled, kingdoms gave way; He gave forth His voice, the earth was shaken.
verses.45:8: The Lord of hosts is with us; our protector is the God of Jacob. Interlude.
verses.45:9: Come, see the works of the Lord, what wonders He has set upon the earth,
verses.45:10: doing away with wars to the ends of the earth; He shall shatter the bow and break the weapon in pieces, and shields He shall burn up in fire.
verses.45:11: "Rest, and know that I am God; I shall be exalted among the nations, I shall be exalted in the earth."
verses.45:12: The Lord of hosts is with us; our protector is the God of Jacob.
verses.46:1: For the end; a psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.46:2: All you nations, clap your hands; shout aloud to God with a voice of exultation.
verses.46:3: For the Lord Most High is to be feared, a great King over all the earth.
verses.46:4: He has subjected peoples to us, and nations beneath our feet;
verses.46:5: He has chosen for us His inheritance, the beauty of Jacob, which He loved. Interlude.
verses.46:6: God has ascended with a shout, the Lord with the voice of a trumpet.
verses.46:7: Sing psalms to our God, sing psalms; sing psalms to our King, sing psalms;
verses.46:8: for God is King of all the earth; sing psalms with understanding.
verses.46:9: God has reigned over the nations; God sits upon His holy throne.
verses.46:10: The rulers of the peoples have gathered together with the God of Abraham, for God's mighty ones of the earth have been exceedingly exalted.
verses.47:1: A Psalm of a song for the sons of Korah, for the second day of the week.
verses.47:2: Great is the Lord, and exceedingly worthy to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain,
verses.47:3: well-rooted, the exultation of all the earth; the mountains of Zion, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.47:4: God is known within her citadels when He comes to her defense.
verses.47:5: For behold, the kings assembled; they came together as one.
verses.47:6: Seeing it thus, they marveled; they were troubled, they were shaken;
verses.47:7: trembling laid hold of them, and there were pangs as of a woman in childbirth.
verses.47:8: With a violent wind You will shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.47:9: Just as we heard, so we have seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God; God has established her forever. Interlude.
verses.47:10: We have received Your mercy, O God, in the midst of Your people.
verses.47:11: As is Your name, O God, so also is Your praise to the farthest bounds of the earth; full of righteousness is Your right hand.
verses.47:12: Let Mount Zion be glad, let the daughters of Judea exult because of Your judgments, O Lord.
verses.47:13: Encircle Zion and encompass her; tell of it among her towers;
verses.47:14: set your hearts upon her strength, and apportion her citadels, that you may declare it to another generation.
verses.47:15: For this is our God forever, even forever and ever.
verses.48:1: To the end: a Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.48:2: Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all who inhabit the world,
verses.48:3: both the earthborn and the sons of men, rich and poor together.
verses.48:4: My mouth shall declare wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall bring forth understanding.
verses.48:5: I will bend my ear to a parable; upon the psaltery I will unfold my riddle.
verses.48:6: Why should I fear in an evil day? The iniquity of my heel will encompass me,
verses.48:7: they who trust in their strength and boast in the abundance of their wealth.
verses.48:8: A brother does not redeem; shall a man redeem? He shall not give to God his own propitiation,
verses.48:9: nor the price of the redemption of his soul; and he has toiled forever,
verses.48:10: and he shall live to the end, for he will not see corruption,
verses.48:11: when he sees wise men dying. Together the senseless and the fool shall perish, and they shall leave their riches to strangers.
verses.48:12: And their tombs are their houses forever, their dwelling places from generation to generation; they have called their own names upon their lands.
verses.48:13: Yet man, being in honor, did not understand; he was compared to the senseless beasts and became like them.
verses.48:14: This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them, yet afterward they shall give blessing with their mouth. Interlude.
verses.48:15: Like sheep they are laid in Hades; death shepherds them. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning, and their help shall grow old in Hades, away from their glory.
verses.48:16: Nevertheless, God will redeem my soul from the hand of Hades when He receives me. Interlude.
verses.48:17: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, and when the glory of his house is multiplied;
verses.48:18: for when he dies he shall take nothing at all, neither shall his glory descend with him.
verses.48:19: For his soul shall be blessed in his lifetime; he will give thanks to You when You do good to him.
verses.48:20: He shall enter even to the generation of his fathers; forever he shall not see light.
verses.48:21: Man, being in honor, did not understand; he was compared to the senseless beasts and became like them.
verses.49:1: A Psalm of Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, has spoken and summoned the earth from the rising of the sun even to its setting.
verses.49:2: Out of Zion is the splendor of His beauty.
verses.49:3: God shall come manifestly, even our God, and He shall not keep silent; a fire shall burn before Him, and all around Him a mighty tempest.
verses.49:4: He shall summon the heaven above and the earth, to judge His people.
verses.49:5: Gather to Him His holy ones, those who establish His covenant over sacrifices.
verses.49:6: And the heavens shall proclaim His righteousness, for God is Judge. Interlude.
verses.49:7: "Hear, My people, and I will speak to you; O Israel, and I will bear solemn witness to you: I am God, your God.
verses.49:8: I will not reprove you on account of your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are continually before Me;
verses.49:9: I will not accept young bulls from your house, nor male goats from your flocks.
verses.49:10: For Mine are all the wild beasts of the forest, the cattle upon the mountains, and the oxen;
verses.49:11: I know all the birds of heaven, and the beauty of the field is with Me.
verses.49:12: If I should hunger, I would by no means tell you; for Mine is the world and its fullness.
verses.49:13: Shall I eat the flesh of bulls? Or shall I drink the blood of goats?
verses.49:14: Sacrifice to God a sacrifice of praise, and render your vows to the Most High;
verses.49:15: and call upon Me in the day of affliction, and I will rescue you, and you shall glorify Me." Interlude.
verses.49:16: But to the sinner God said, "Why do you recount My ordinances, and take up My covenant with your mouth?
verses.49:17: Yet you hated discipline, and cast My words behind you.
verses.49:18: If you saw a thief, you ran along with him, and with adulterers you placed your portion;
verses.49:19: your mouth multiplied malice, and your tongue wove deceit;
verses.49:20: sitting down, you slandered your brother, and against the son of your mother you laid a stumbling block.
verses.49:21: These things you did, and I kept silent; you supposed lawlessness, that I would be like you. I will reprove you and set it before your face.
verses.49:22: Understand these things now, you who forget God, lest He snatch you away, and there be none to deliver.
verses.49:23: A sacrifice of praise shall glorify Me, and there is the way by which I will show him the salvation of God."
verses.50:1: For the end; a psalm of David,
verses.50:2: when Nathan the prophet came to him, when he had gone in to Bathsheba.
verses.50:3: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your great mercy; and according to the multitude of Your compassions, blot out my transgression.
verses.50:4: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.50:5: For I myself know my iniquity, and my sin is before me continually.
verses.50:6: Against You alone I have sinned, and I have done what is evil before You, so that You may be justified in Your words, and prevail when You are judged.
verses.50:7: For behold, in iniquities I was conceived, and in sins my mother conceived me.
verses.50:8: For behold, You have loved truth; the unseen and hidden things of Your wisdom You have made known to me.
verses.50:9: You shall sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed; You shall wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.
verses.50:10: You shall make me hear exultation and gladness; the humbled bones shall rejoice.
verses.50:11: Turn away Your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
verses.50:12: Create a clean heart in me, O God, and renew an upright spirit within my inward parts.
verses.50:13: Do not cast me off from Your presence, and do not remove Your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.50:14: Restore to me the exultation of Your salvation, and establish me with a governing spirit.
verses.50:15: I will teach the lawless Your ways, and the ungodly shall return to You.
verses.50:16: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation; my tongue shall rejoice in Your righteousness,
verses.50:17: O Lord. You shall open my lips, and my mouth shall declare Your praise.
verses.50:18: For if You had desired sacrifice, I would have given it; You will take no pleasure in whole burnt offerings.
verses.50:19: A sacrifice to God is a broken spirit; a broken and humbled heart God will not despise.
verses.50:20: Do good, O Lord, in Your good pleasure to Zion, and let the walls of Jerusalem be built.
verses.50:21: Then You shall be pleased with a sacrifice of righteousness, an offering and whole burnt offerings; then they shall offer up calves upon Your altar.
verses.51:1: For the end; of understanding, of David,
verses.51:2: when Doeg the Edomite came and reported to Saul, and said to him, "David has come into the house of Abimelech."
verses.51:3: Why do you boast in wickedness, O mighty man, of iniquity all day long?
verses.51:4: Your tongue has devised unrighteousness; like a sharpened razor, you have practiced deceit.
verses.51:5: You have loved wickedness more than goodness, unrighteousness more than speaking righteousness. Interlude.
verses.51:6: You have loved all words of ruin, a deceitful tongue.
verses.51:7: Therefore God shall tear you down forever; may He pluck you up and banish you from the dwelling, and your root from the land of the living. Interlude.
verses.51:8: And the righteous shall see and fear, and shall laugh at him, and say,
verses.51:9: "Behold, a man who did not make God his helper, but set his hope upon the abundance of his riches, and grew strong in his vanity."
verses.51:10: But I am like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God; I have set my hope upon the mercy of God forever and ever.
verses.51:11: I will give thanks to You forever, because You have done it; and I will wait upon Your name, for it is good before Your holy ones.
verses.52:1: For the end, concerning Maeleth; of understanding, of David.
verses.52:2: A fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They have become corrupt and have become abominable in iniquities; there is no one who does good.
verses.52:3: God looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see if there is anyone who understands, or who seeks after God.
verses.52:4: All have turned aside; together they have become unprofitable; there is no one who does good, there is not even one.
verses.52:5: Shall not all who work iniquity know, who eat my people as a meal of bread? They have not called upon God.
verses.52:6: There they shall fear with dread where there was no fear, for God has scattered the bones of those who please men; they have been put to shame, because God has despised them.
verses.52:7: Who will give out of Zion the salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back the captivity of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.53:1: For the end, in hymns; of understanding, for David,
verses.53:2: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Behold, is not David hidden with us?"
verses.53:3: O God, by Your name save me, and by Your power judge me.
verses.53:4: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.53:5: For strangers have risen against me, and mighty men have sought my soul; they have not placed God before them. Pause.
verses.53:6: For behold, God helps me, and the Lord is the upholder of my soul.
verses.53:7: He shall turn back the evils upon my enemies; in Your truth utterly destroy them.
verses.53:8: Willingly I will sacrifice to You; I will give thanks to Your name, for it is good;
verses.53:9: for out of every affliction You have delivered me, and upon my enemies my eye has looked.
verses.54:1: For the end, in hymns; of understanding, for David.
verses.54:2: Give ear, O God, to my prayer, and do not overlook my supplication;
verses.54:3: attend to me and hear me. I was grieved in my meditation, and I was troubled
verses.54:4: at the voice of an enemy and at the affliction of a sinner; for they turned iniquity upon me, and in wrath they harbored malice against me.
verses.54:5: My heart was troubled within me, and the dread of death fell upon me.
verses.54:6: Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.
verses.54:7: And I said, "Who will give me wings like a dove, and I will fly away and find rest?"
verses.54:8: Behold, I went far off in flight, and I lodged in the wilderness. Pause.
verses.54:9: I awaited Him who saves me from faintheartedness and tempest.
verses.54:10: Submerge, O Lord, and divide their tongues, for I have seen lawlessness and contention in the city.
verses.54:11: Day and night it shall encircle her upon her walls; iniquity and toil are in her midst
verses.54:12: and unrighteousness; and trouble and deceit have not ceased from her streets.
verses.54:13: For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have borne it; and if he who hates had spoken boastfully against me, I would have hidden myself from him.
verses.54:14: But it was you, a man of like soul, my guide and my familiar friend,
verses.54:15: who together sweetened meals; in the house of God we walked in concord.
verses.54:16: Let death come upon them, and let them go down into Hades alive; for evils are in their dwellings, in their midst.
verses.54:17: As for me, I cried out to God, and the Lord heard me.
verses.54:18: At evening and morning and noonday I will declare; I will proclaim, and He shall hear my voice.
verses.54:19: He shall redeem my soul in peace from those who draw near to me, for among many they were with me.
verses.54:20: God shall hear and humble them, He who exists before the ages. Pause.
verses.54:21: For there is no exchange for them, and they did not fear God. He stretched forth His hand in recompense; they profaned His covenant.
verses.54:22: They were divided from the wrath of His countenance, and his heart drew near; his words were softer than oil, yet they are darts.
verses.54:23: Cast your care upon the Lord, and He Himself shall nourish you; He shall never give wavering to the righteous.
verses.54:24: But You, O God, shall bring them down into the pit of corruption; men of blood and deceit shall by no means live out half their days; but as for me, I will hope in You, O Lord.
verses.55:1: For the end, concerning the people removed far from the holy places; for David, for a pillar inscription, when the foreigners seized him in Gath.
verses.55:2: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for man has trampled me down; warring all the day long, he has afflicted me.
verses.55:3: My enemies have trampled me down all the day long from the height of the day; for many who make war against me
verses.55:4: shall be afraid, but as for me, I will hope in You.
verses.55:5: In God I will praise my words all the day long; in God I have hoped; I will not fear what flesh shall do to me.
verses.55:6: All the day long they abhorred my words; against me are all their thoughts for evil.
verses.55:7: They shall dwell near and hide themselves; they shall watch my heel, just as I waited in my soul;
verses.55:8: For nothingness will You save them? In wrath You shall bring down peoples. O God,
verses.55:9: I have declared my life to You; You have set my tears before You, even as in Your promise.
verses.55:10: My enemies shall turn backward in whatever day I call upon You; behold, I know that You are my God.
verses.55:11: In God I will praise an utterance; in God I will praise a word.
verses.55:12: In God I have hoped; I will not fear what man shall do to me.
verses.55:13: In me, O God, are the vows of praise that I will pay;
verses.55:14: for You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from slipping, that I may be well-pleasing before God in the light of the living.
verses.56:1: To the end: "Do not destroy." Of David, for a pillar inscription, when he fled from the face of Saul into the cave.
verses.56:2: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, for in You my soul has trusted; and in the shadow of Your wings I will hope until iniquity passes by.
verses.56:3: I will cry aloud to God the Most High, to God who has done good to me. Interlude.
verses.56:4: He sent forth from heaven and saved me; He gave over to reproach those who trample upon me. God sent forth His mercy and His truth,
verses.56:5: and He delivered my soul from the midst of young lions. I lay down troubled; the sons of men—their teeth are a weapon and arrows, and their tongue is a sharp sword.
verses.56:6: Be exalted over the heavens, O God, and may Your glory be over all the earth.
verses.56:7: They prepared snares for my feet and bowed down my soul; they dug a pit before my face and fell into it. Interlude.
verses.56:8: My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready; I will sing and make melody.
verses.56:9: Awake, my glory! Awake, psaltery and harp! I will awaken at dawn.
verses.56:10: I will give thanks to You among the peoples, O Lord; I will sing psalms to You among the nations,
verses.56:11: for Your mercy has been magnified even to the heavens, and Your truth to the clouds.
verses.56:12: Be exalted over the heavens, O God, and may Your glory be over all the earth.
verses.57:1: To the end: "Do not destroy." Of David, for a pillar inscription.
verses.57:2: Do you indeed speak righteousness in truth? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
verses.57:3: For indeed in heart you work iniquities upon the earth; your hands weave together unrighteousness.
verses.57:4: Sinners have been estranged from the womb; they went astray from the belly; they spoke falsehoods.
verses.57:5: Their fury is after the likeness of a serpent, like that of a deaf asp that stops up its ears,
verses.57:6: which will not heed the voice of charmers, nor of a charm prepared by a wise man.
verses.57:7: God crushed their teeth in their mouth; the Lord shattered the jaw teeth of the lions.
verses.57:8: They shall be brought to nothing like water passing away; He will bend His bow until they grow weak.
verses.57:9: Like wax that melts, they shall be taken away; fire fell, and they did not see the sun.
verses.57:10: Before your thorns understand the bramble, as though alive, as though in wrath, He will swallow you up.
verses.57:11: The righteous man shall rejoice when he sees vengeance upon the ungodly; he shall wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.
verses.57:12: And a man shall say, "Is there indeed fruit for the righteous? Surely, then, there is God who judges them upon the earth."
verses.58:1: To the end: "Do not destroy." Of David, for a pillar inscription, when Saul sent and watched his house to put him to death.
verses.58:2: Rescue me from my enemies, O God, and from those who rise up against me, redeem me.
verses.58:3: Deliver me from those who work lawlessness, and save me from men of blood.
verses.58:4: For behold, they have hunted my soul; mighty men have set upon me—neither is it my iniquity nor my sin, O Lord.
verses.58:5: Without iniquity I ran and kept a straight course; awake to meet me, and see,
verses.58:6: and You, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, give heed to visit all the nations; do not have compassion on any who work lawlessness. Interlude.
verses.58:7: They shall return at evening, and they shall hunger like a dog and go around a city.
verses.58:8: Behold, they will speak forth with their mouth, and a sword is on their lips; "For who has heard?"
verses.58:9: And You, O Lord, shall laugh at them; You shall hold all the nations in contempt.
verses.58:10: My strength I will keep for You, for You are God, my protector.
verses.58:11: My God—His mercy shall go before me; my God shall let me look upon my enemies.
verses.58:12: Do not slay them, lest they forget Your law; scatter them by Your power and bring them down, O Lord, my defender.
verses.58:13: For the sin of their mouth and the word of their lips, let them be caught in their pride; and because of cursing and falsehood there shall be proclaimed
verses.58:14: complete destructions, in the wrath of complete destruction, and they shall be no more; and they shall know that the God of Jacob rules over the ends of the earth. Interlude.
verses.58:15: They shall return at evening, and they shall hunger like a dog and go around a city;
verses.58:16: they shall be scattered abroad to eat, and if they are satisfied, they shall also murmur.
verses.58:17: But I will sing of Your power, and in the morning I will exult in Your mercy; for You have become my protector and a refuge in a day of affliction.
verses.58:18: O my helper, to You I will make melody, O my God; for You are my protector, O my God, my mercy.
verses.59:1: For the end; for those who shall be changed; still for a pillar inscription of David, for instruction,
verses.59:2: when he set fire to Mesopotamia of Syria and Syria of Sobal, and Joab returned and struck the Valley of Salt, twelve thousand.
verses.59:3: O God, You have cast us off and torn us down; You were angry, and You had compassion on us.
verses.59:4: You have shaken the earth and thrown it into turmoil; heal its breaches, for they have been shaken.
verses.59:5: You have shown Your people hard things; You have made us drink the wine of stupor.
verses.59:6: You have given a sign to those who fear You, that they may flee from before the bow. Interlude.
verses.59:7: That Your beloved ones may be delivered, save with Your right hand and hear me.
verses.59:8: God has spoken in His holy place: "I will greatly rejoice and divide Shechem, and I will measure out the Valley of Tents.
verses.59:9: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine, and Ephraim is the strength of My head; Judah is My king,
verses.59:10: Moab is the cauldron of My hope; over Idumea I will stretch out My sandal; to Me the foreigners have been subjected."
verses.59:11: Who will lead me into a fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Idumea?
verses.59:12: Is it not You, O God, who have cast us off? And will You not go forth, O God, with our armies?
verses.59:13: Give us help from affliction, and vain is the salvation of man.
verses.59:14: Yet in God we shall act with might, and He Himself will bring to nothing those who afflict us.
verses.60:1: For the end, in hymns; of David.
verses.60:2: Hear my supplication; give heed to my prayer.
verses.60:3: From the ends of the earth I cried out to You when my heart grew faint; upon a rock You lifted me up, You guided me,
verses.60:4: for You have become my hope, a tower of strength from before the enemy.
verses.60:5: I will sojourn in Your tabernacle forever. Interlude. I will be sheltered in the shelter of Your wings.
verses.60:6: For You, O God, have heard my prayers; You have given an inheritance to those who fear Your name.
verses.60:7: You will add days to the days of the king, his years until the day of generation and generation.
verses.60:8: He shall abide forever before God; His mercy and truth—who will seek them out?
verses.60:9: So I will sing praise to Your name forever and ever, that I may pay my vows day by day.
verses.61:1: For the end, for Jeduthun; a psalm of David.
verses.61:2: Shall not my soul be subject to God? For from Him is my salvation.
verses.61:3: For He indeed is my God and my Savior, my protector; I shall by no means be shaken any further.
verses.61:4: How long will you assail a man? All of you slay, as against a leaning wall and a pushed-in fence.
verses.61:5: Yet they took counsel to thrust away my honor; they ran in thirst; with their mouth they blessed, and in their heart they cursed. Interlude.
verses.61:6: Yet be subject to God, O my soul, for from Him is my endurance.
verses.61:7: For He is my God and my Savior, my protector; I shall by no means be moved away.
verses.61:8: In God is my salvation and my glory; the God of my help, and my hope is in God.
verses.61:9: Hope in Him, every congregation of people; pour out your hearts before Him; God is our helper. Interlude.
verses.61:10: Yet the sons of men are vain; the sons of men are false in the balances to do injustice; they are of vanity altogether.
verses.61:11: Do not hope in injustice, and do not long for plunder; if wealth flows in, do not set your heart upon it.
verses.61:12: Once God has spoken; these two things I have heard: that power belongs to God,
verses.61:13: and to You, O Lord, belongs mercy; for You will render to each one according to his works.
verses.62:1: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Idumea.
verses.62:2: O God, my God, to You I rise at dawn; my soul has thirsted for You, how manifoldly my flesh also for You, in a desert land, trackless and waterless,
verses.62:3: thus in the sanctuary I appeared before You, to behold Your power and Your glory.
verses.62:4: For Your mercy is better than lives; my lips shall praise You.
verses.62:5: Thus I will bless You in my life; in Your name I will lift up my hands.
verses.62:6: As with marrow and richness may my soul be filled, and lips of exultation shall praise Your name.
verses.62:7: If I remembered You upon my bed, at my dawn I meditated upon You;
verses.62:8: for You have become my helper, and in the shelter of Your wings I will exult.
verses.62:9: My soul has clung closely behind You; Your right hand has upheld me.
verses.62:10: Yet they have sought my soul in vain; they shall enter into the lowest parts of the earth;
verses.62:11: they shall be delivered over into the hands of the sword; they shall be portions for foxes.
verses.62:12: But the king shall be glad in God; everyone who swears by Him shall be praised, for the mouth of those who speak unjust things has been stopped.
verses.63:1: For the end; a Psalm of David.
verses.63:2: Give ear, O God, to my prayer when I make supplication to You; from the dread of the enemy deliver my soul.
verses.63:3: You have sheltered me from the conspiracy of evildoers, from the multitude of those who work injustice,
verses.63:4: who have sharpened their tongues like a sword and bent a bow, a bitter thing,
verses.63:5: to shoot down the blameless in secret places; suddenly they will shoot him down and will not fear.
verses.63:6: They have strengthened for themselves an evil word; they spoke of hiding snares; they said, "Who will see them?"
verses.63:7: They searched out lawlessness; they grew faint searching with diligent search; a man shall draw near, and a deep heart,
verses.63:8: and God shall be exalted. Their blows have become the arrow of infants,
verses.63:9: and their tongues have brought him to nothing. All who beheld them were troubled,
verses.63:10: and every man feared; and they declared the works of God and understood His deeds.
verses.63:11: The righteous man shall be glad in the Lord and shall hope in Him; and all the upright in heart shall be praised.
verses.64:1: For the end; a Psalm of David, a Song.
verses.64:2: To You a hymn is fitting, O God, in Zion, and to You a vow shall be paid.
verses.64:3: Give ear to my prayer; to You all flesh shall come.
verses.64:4: Words of lawless men have overpowered us, and You shall make atonement for our impieties.
verses.64:5: Blessed is the one whom You have chosen and taken to Yourself; he shall dwell in Your courts. We shall be filled with the good things of Your house; holy is Your temple,
verses.64:6: wondrous in righteousness. Hear us, O God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth,
verses.64:7: who establishes mountains by Your strength, being girded with might;
verses.64:8: who stirs up the water of the sea, the roarings of its waves. The nations shall be troubled,
verses.64:9: and those who dwell at the utmost bounds shall fear at Your signs; the outgoings of morning and evening You shall gladden.
verses.64:10: You have visited the earth and drenched it; You have abounded in enriching it; the river of God has been filled with waters; You have prepared their food, for thus is Your preparation.
verses.64:11: Drench its furrows, multiply its produce; in its raindrops it shall be glad as it springs forth.
verses.64:12: You shall bless the crown of the year of Your goodness, and Your plains shall be filled with richness;
verses.64:13: the mountains of the wilderness shall be made rich, and the hills shall gird themselves with exultation.
verses.64:14: The rams of the sheep have clothed themselves, and the valleys shall abound with grain; they shall shout aloud, for indeed they shall sing hymns.
verses.65:1: For the end; a song of a psalm of resurrection. Shout joyfully to God, all the earth,
verses.65:2: sing psalms indeed to His name; give glory to His praise.
verses.65:3: Say to God, "How awesome are Your works! In the multitude of Your power Your enemies shall lie to You;
verses.65:4: let all the earth worship You and sing psalms to You; let them sing psalms to Your name." Interlude.
verses.65:5: Come, children, and see the works of God; He is awesome in counsels beyond the sons of men.
verses.65:6: He turns the sea into dry land; through the river they shall pass on foot. There we shall rejoice in Him,
verses.65:7: who rules by the dominion of His eternity. His eyes look upon the nations; let the rebellious not be exalted in themselves. Interlude.
verses.65:8: Bless our God, O nations, and make the voice of His praise heard,
verses.65:9: who has set my soul in life, and has not given my feet over to shaking.
verses.65:10: For You have proved us, O God, and You have tried us by fire as silver is tried.
verses.65:11: You brought us into the snare; You laid afflictions before us.
verses.65:12: You caused men to ride over our heads; we passed through fire and water, and You brought us out into refreshment.
verses.65:13: I will enter into Your house with whole burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,
verses.65:14: which my lips distinctly uttered and my mouth spoke in my affliction.
verses.65:15: I will offer up to You whole burnt offerings full of marrow, with incense and rams; I will offer to You oxen with male goats. Interlude.
verses.65:16: Come, hear, and I will recount, all you who fear the Lord, all that He has done for my soul.
verses.65:17: To Him I cried aloud with my mouth, and I exalted Him beneath my tongue.
verses.65:18: If I had regarded unrighteousness in my heart, may the Lord not hear.
verses.65:19: Therefore God has heard me; He has attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.65:20: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me.
verses.66:1: For the end, in hymns; a psalm of David.
verses.66:2: May God have compassion on us and bless us; may He cause His countenance to shine upon us, Interlude.
verses.66:3: that Your way may be known upon the earth, and Your salvation among all nations.
verses.66:4: Let peoples give thanks, O God; let all peoples give thanks.
verses.66:5: Let nations be glad and exult, for You shall judge peoples in uprightness, and You shall guide nations upon the earth. Interlude.
verses.66:6: Let peoples give thanks to You, O God; let all peoples give thanks to You.
verses.66:7: The earth has yielded its fruit; may God, our God, bless us,
verses.66:8: may God bless us, and let all the ends of the earth fear Him.
verses.67:1: For the end; of David, a psalm of a song.
verses.67:2: Let God arise, and let His enemies be scattered, and let those who hate Him flee from His presence.
verses.67:3: As smoke vanishes, let them vanish; as wax melts before fire, so may sinners perish from the presence of God.
verses.67:4: And let the righteous be glad. Interlude. Let them exult before God; let them be delighted in gladness.
verses.67:5: Sing to God, sing psalms to His name; prepare a way for Him who rides upon the west—the Lord is His name—and exult before Him.
verses.67:6: They shall be troubled at His presence, the Father of the orphans and Judge of the widows; God is in His holy place.
verses.67:7: God settles the solitary in a house, leading out the fettered in valor; likewise the rebellious, who dwell in tombs.
verses.67:8: O God, when You went forth before Your people, when You passed through the wilderness, Interlude.
verses.67:9: the earth quaked, and indeed the heavens dripped at the presence of the God of Sinai, at the presence of the God of Israel.
verses.67:10: You shall set apart a voluntary rain, O God, for Your inheritance; and it grew weak, yet You restored it.
verses.67:11: Your living creatures dwell in it; in Your goodness You have prepared for the poor.
verses.67:12: God the Lord shall give a word to those who proclaim good tidings with great power,
verses.67:13: the King of the powers of the beloved, of the beloved, and for the beauty of the house to divide the spoils.
verses.67:14: If you lie down in the midst of the inheritances, wings of a dove overlaid with silver, and her back in the pale luster of gold. Interlude.
verses.67:15: When the Heavenly One separates kings upon it, they shall be made white as snow in Zalmon.
verses.67:16: A mountain of God is a rich mountain; a curdled mountain, a rich mountain.
verses.67:17: Why do you suppose, O curdled mountains? This is the mountain in which God has been well pleased to dwell; for indeed the Lord shall abide there to the end.
verses.67:18: The chariot of God is ten-thousandfold, thousands of those who prosper; the Lord is among them in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.67:19: Having ascended on high, You led captivity captive; You received gifts in man—indeed, even for the disobedient to dwell.
verses.67:20: Blessed is the Lord God, blessed is the Lord day by day; and the God of our salvations shall prosper our way. Interlude.
verses.67:21: Our God is the God who saves, and to the Lord belong the ways out of death.
verses.67:22: Yet God shall shatter the heads of His enemies, the hairy crown of those who walk on, each in his trespasses.
verses.67:23: The Lord said, "From Bashan I will turn back; I will turn back in the depths of the sea,
verses.67:24: so that your foot may be dipped in blood, and the tongue of your dogs dipped in it from the enemies."
verses.67:25: Your processions have been seen, O God, the processions of my God, of the King who is in the holy place.
verses.67:26: Princes went before, next to those who sing psalms, in the midst of maidens playing timbrels.
verses.67:27: In the assemblies bless God, the Lord from the fountains of Israel.
verses.67:28: There is Benjamin, the youngest, in ecstasy; the princes of Judah, their leaders; the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
verses.67:29: Command Your strength, O God; strengthen, O God, this which You have established for us.
verses.67:30: From Your temple at Jerusalem kings shall bring gifts to You.
verses.67:31: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reed, the assembly of the bulls among the heifers of the peoples, so that those who are tested with silver may not be shut out; scatter the nations that desire wars.
verses.67:32: Envoys shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall hasten her hand to God.
verses.67:33: O kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; sing psalms to the Lord. Interlude.
verses.67:34: Sing psalms to God, who rides upon the heaven of heaven toward the east. Behold, He shall give in His voice a voice of power.
verses.67:35: Give glory to God; His majesty is over Israel, and His power is in the clouds.
verses.67:36: Wondrous is God among His devout ones; the God of Israel, He Himself shall give power and might to His people; and blessed be God.
verses.68:1: For the end, concerning those who shall be changed; of David.
verses.68:2: Save me, O God, for the waters have entered even to my soul.
verses.68:3: I have sunk fast into the mire of the deep, and there is no foothold; I have come into the depths of the sea, and a tempest has submerged me.
verses.68:4: I have grown weary with crying out, my throat has become hoarse; my eyes have failed from drawing near to my God.
verses.68:5: Those who hate me without cause have multiplied beyond the hairs of my head; my enemies who persecute me unjustly have grown strong; what I did not seize, then I repaid.
verses.68:6: O God, You know my foolishness, and my trespasses have not been hidden from You.
verses.68:7: Do not let those who wait upon You be put to shame because of me, O Lord of hosts; do not let those who seek You be disgraced because of me, O God of Israel.
verses.68:8: For because of You I have borne reproach; dishonor has covered my face.
verses.68:9: I have become estranged from my brethren, and a stranger to the sons of my mother;
verses.68:10: for the zeal of Your house shall consume me, and the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen upon me.
verses.68:11: And I bowed down my soul with fasting, and it became a reproach to me;
verses.68:12: and I made sackcloth my garment, and I became a proverb to them.
verses.68:13: Those who sit in the gate spoke against me, and those who drink wine sang songs against me.
verses.68:14: But as for me, my prayer is to You, O Lord; it is a time of favor, O God; in the multitude of Your mercy give ear, in the truth of Your salvation.
verses.68:15: Save me from the mire, lest I sink fast; may I be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the depth of the waters.
verses.68:16: Do not let a tempest of water submerge me, nor let the deep swallow me up, nor let the pit shut its mouth over me.
verses.68:17: Hear me, O Lord, for Your mercy is good; according to the multitude of Your compassions look upon me.
verses.68:18: For I am in distress; quickly hear me.
verses.68:19: Attend to my soul and redeem it; because of my enemies, deliver me.
verses.68:20: For You know my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor; all those who afflict me are before You.
verses.68:21: My soul expected reproach and misery; and I waited for one to grieve with me, and there was none, and for a comforter, and I found none.
verses.68:22: And they put gall into my food, and for my thirst they made me drink vinegar.
verses.68:23: Let their table before them become a snare, and a recompense, and a stumbling block;
verses.68:24: let their eyes be darkened so that they do not see, and bow down their back continually.
verses.68:25: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and may the fierceness of Your anger overtake them.
verses.68:26: Let their habitation become desolate, and let no one dwell in their tents;
verses.68:27: for they persecuted him whom You struck, and they added to the pain of my wounds.
verses.68:28: Add iniquity to their iniquity, and do not let them enter into Your righteousness;
verses.68:29: let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and do not let them be written with the righteous.
verses.68:30: I am poor and in pain, and the salvation of Your countenance has upheld me.
verses.68:31: I will praise the name of God with a song; I will magnify Him with praise,
verses.68:32: and it shall please God more than a young calf bringing forth horns and hooves.
verses.68:33: Let the poor see and be glad; seek God earnestly, and you shall live.
verses.68:34: For the Lord has heard the needy, and He has not despised His prisoners.
verses.68:35: Let the heavens and the earth praise Him, the sea and all things that move in them.
verses.68:36: For God will save Zion, and the cities of Judea shall be built, and they shall dwell there and inherit it;
verses.68:37: and the seed of His servants shall possess it, and those who love His name shall dwell in it.
verses.69:1: For the end; of David, for a remembrance, that the Lord may save me.
verses.69:2: O God, attend to my help.
verses.69:3: May those who seek my soul be ashamed and disgraced; may those who desire evil for me be turned back and put to shame;
verses.69:4: may those who say to me, "Aha, aha!" be turned back immediately in shame.
verses.69:5: Let all those who seek You exult and be glad in You; and let those who love Your salvation say continually, "Let God be magnified!"
verses.69:6: But I am poor and needy; O God, help me. You are my helper and my deliverer; O Lord, do not delay.
verses.70:1: Of David, of the sons of Jonadab and of the first who were taken captive. O God, in You I have hoped; may I not be put to shame forever.
verses.70:2: In Your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; incline Your ear to me and save me.
verses.70:3: Be to me a God of protection, a fortified place to save me; for You are my stronghold and my refuge.
verses.70:4: O God, deliver me out of the hand of the sinner, out of the hand of the transgressor and the wrongdoer;
verses.70:5: for You are my expectation, O Lord; the Lord is my hope from my youth.
verses.70:6: Upon You I have been supported from the womb; from the womb of my mother You are my protector; in You is my hymn of praise continually.
verses.70:7: I have become as a wonder to the many, and You are a mighty helper.
verses.70:8: Let my mouth be filled with praise, that I may sing of Your glory, and all the day long of Your majesty.
verses.70:9: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
verses.70:10: For my enemies have spoken against me, and those who watch for my soul have taken counsel together,
verses.70:11: saying, "God has forsaken him; pursue and overtake him, for there is none to deliver."
verses.70:12: O God, do not be far from me.
verses.70:13: Let those who slander my soul be put to shame and fail; let those who seek evil for me be clothed with shame and dishonor.
verses.70:14: But as for me, I will hope continually, and I will add to all Your praise.
verses.70:15: My mouth shall declare Your righteousness, and all the day long Your salvation, for I have not known business dealings.
verses.70:16: I will enter in the might of the Lord; O Lord, I will remember Your righteousness alone.
verses.70:17: You have taught me, O God, from my youth, and until now I will declare Your wondrous works,
verses.70:18: and even to old age and advanced years; O God, do not forsake me until I proclaim Your arm to every generation that is to come, Your mighty power,
verses.70:19: and Your righteousness, O God, even to the highest, the great things which You have done. O God, who is like You?
verses.70:20: For You have shown me many afflictions and evils, and turning again You gave me life, and from the depths of the earth You brought me up again,
verses.70:21: multiplying Your righteousness; and turning again You comforted me, and from the depths You brought me up again.
verses.70:22: For I will also give thanks to You with an instrument of psalmody for Your truth; I will sing praise to You, O God, with the harp, O Holy One of Israel.
verses.70:23: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing praise to You, and my soul which You have redeemed.
verses.70:24: Moreover, my tongue also shall meditate on Your righteousness all the day long, when those who seek evil for me are put to shame and disgraced.
verses.71:1: For Solomon. O God, give Your judgment to the king, and Your righteousness to the son of the king,
verses.71:2: to judge Your people in righteousness, and Your poor in judgment.
verses.71:3: Let the mountains lift up peace for Your people, and the hills.
verses.71:4: In righteousness he will judge the poor of the people; and You will save the sons of the needy, and he will humble the slanderer.
verses.71:5: And he shall endure with the sun, and before the moon, through generations of generations.
verses.71:6: And he shall come down like rain upon a fleece, and like drops dripping upon the earth.
verses.71:7: In his days righteousness shall spring forth, and abundance of peace until the moon is taken away.
verses.71:8: And he shall have dominion from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the inhabited world.
verses.71:9: Before him the Ethiopians shall fall down, and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.71:10: The kings of Tarshish and the islands shall offer gifts; the kings of the Arabs and of Sheba shall bring gifts.
verses.71:11: And all the kings shall bow down to him; all the nations shall serve him.
verses.71:12: For he delivered the poor from the hand of the mighty, and the needy who had no helper.
verses.71:13: He will spare the poor and the needy, and he will save the souls of the needy.
verses.71:14: From usury and from unrighteousness he will redeem their souls, and honorable shall their name be before him.
verses.71:15: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Arabia; and they shall pray for him continually; all the day they shall bless him.
verses.71:16: There shall be a firm support in the earth upon the tops of the mountains; its fruit shall be lifted high above Lebanon, and they shall flourish out of the city like the grass of the earth.
verses.71:17: Let his name be blessed forever; before the sun his name shall abide; and in him all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed; all the nations shall call him blessed.
verses.71:18: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who alone does wondrous things,
verses.71:19: and blessed be the name of His glory forever, and forever and ever; and all the earth shall be filled with His glory. So be it, so be it.
verses.71:20: The hymns of David, the son of Jesse, have come to an end.
verses.72:1: A Psalm of Asaph. How good God is to Israel, to the upright in heart!
verses.72:2: But as for me, my feet had almost been shaken; my steps had nearly been poured out.
verses.72:3: For I was envious of the lawless, when I beheld the peace of sinners.
verses.72:4: For there is no respite in their death, and there is firmness in their scourge.
verses.72:5: They are not in the toils of men, and they shall not be scourged with men.
verses.72:6: Therefore pride has taken hold of them; they have clothed themselves with their unrighteousness and ungodliness.
verses.72:7: Their unrighteousness shall come forth as out of fatness; they have passed into the disposition of the heart.
verses.72:8: They have schemed and spoken in wickedness; unrighteousness they have spoken to the height.
verses.72:9: They have set their mouth against heaven, and their tongue has passed over the earth.
verses.72:10: Therefore my people shall return here, and full days shall be found for them.
verses.72:11: And they said, "How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?"
verses.72:12: Behold, sinners—and they prosper; forever they have laid hold of wealth.
verses.72:13: And I said, "Surely in vain I have justified my heart, and washed my hands among the innocent,
verses.72:14: and I have been scourged all the day, and my reproof is in the mornings."
verses.72:15: If I had said, "I will declare thus," behold, I would have broken faith with the generation of Your sons.
verses.72:16: And I undertook to understand; this was a toil before me,
verses.72:17: until I entered into the sanctuary of God, and understood the last things.
verses.72:18: Nevertheless, because of their deceits You have appointed it for them.
verses.72:19: How have they come to desolation? Suddenly they have vanished; they have perished because of their lawlessness.
verses.72:20: Like the dream of one who awakens, O Lord, in Your city You shall despise their image.
verses.72:21: For my heart was gladdened, and my inward parts were changed;
verses.72:22: and I was brought to nothing and did not know; I became like a beast before You.
verses.72:23: Yet I am continually with You; You have taken hold of my right hand;
verses.72:24: in Your counsel You have guided me, and with glory You have received me.
verses.72:25: For what do I have in heaven? And besides You, what have I desired upon the earth?
verses.72:26: My heart and my flesh have failed, O God of my heart; and God is my portion forever.
verses.72:27: For behold, those who remove themselves far from You shall perish; You have utterly destroyed everyone who commits harlotry away from You.
verses.72:28: But as for me, it is good to cling to the Lord, to place my hope in the Lord, that I may declare all Your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
verses.73:1: Of understanding, for Asaph. Why have You cast us off, O God, forever? Has Your wrath raged against the sheep of Your pasture?
verses.73:2: Remember Your congregation, which You acquired from the beginning; You redeemed the rod of Your inheritance, this Mount Zion in which You have dwelt.
verses.73:3: Lift up Your hands against their arrogance forever, because of all the evil the enemy has done in Your holy places.
verses.73:4: And those who hate You have boasted in the midst of Your feast,
verses.73:5: as at the entrance above; as in a thicket of trees with axes they cut down
verses.73:6: its doors; altogether with hatchet and chisel they smashed it down.
verses.73:7: They burned Your sanctuary with fire; to the ground they profaned the tabernacle of Your name.
verses.73:8: Their kindred altogether said in their heart, "Come, and let us put an end to the feasts of the Lord from the earth."
verses.73:9: We have not seen our signs; there is no longer a prophet, and He will know us no more.
verses.73:10: How long, O God, shall the enemy reproach? Shall the adversary provoke Your name forever?
verses.73:11: Why do You turn away Your hand, and Your right hand from the midst of Your bosom forever?
verses.73:12: Yet our King from before the age has wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.73:13: You made firm the sea by Your power; You shattered the heads of the dragons upon the water.
verses.73:14: You gave him as food to the Ethiopian peoples.
verses.73:15: You broke open springs and torrents.
verses.73:16: Yours is the day, and Yours is the night; You fashioned the sun and the moon.
verses.73:17: You made all the borders of the earth; summer and spring You made.
verses.73:18: Remember this Your creation. An enemy has reproached the Lord, and a foolish people has provoked His name.
verses.73:19: Do not deliver to the wild beasts a soul that confesses You; do not forget the souls of Your needy forever.
verses.73:20: Look upon Your covenant, for the darkened places of the earth have been filled with houses of iniquities.
verses.73:21: Do not let the humbled and shamed be turned away; the poor and the needy shall praise Your name.
verses.73:22: Arise, O God, judge Your cause; remember the reproaches against You by a fool all the day.
verses.73:23: Do not forget the voice of Your suppliants; may the pride of those who hate You ascend continually to You.
verses.74:1: For the end; do not destroy; a psalm of a song for Asaph.
verses.74:2: We will give thanks to You, O God, we will give thanks and call upon Your name; I will declare all Your wondrous works,
verses.74:3: when I take an appointed time; I will judge uprightness.
verses.74:4: The earth has melted, and all who dwell in it; I have firmly established its pillars. Interlude.
verses.74:5: I said to those who act lawlessly not to act lawlessly, and to those who sin, "Do not lift up the horn;
verses.74:6: do not raise your horn on high; do not speak unrighteousness against God."
verses.74:7: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the deserts,
verses.74:8: for God is the Judge: this one He humbles, and that one He exalts.
verses.74:9: For a cup is in the hand of the Lord, of unmixed wine, full of mixture, and He has poured from this into that; yet its dregs have not been emptied out, and all the sinners of the earth shall drink.
verses.74:10: But I will rejoice forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob;
verses.74:11: and all the horns of the sinners I will break in pieces, and the horns of the righteous one shall be exalted.
verses.75:1: For the end, with hymns; a psalm for Asaph, a song, concerning the Assyrian.
verses.75:2: God is known in Judea; in Israel His name is great.
verses.75:3: And His place was in peace, and His dwelling place in Zion;
verses.75:4: there He shattered the powers of the bows, shield and sword and battle; there He will break the horns. Interlude.
verses.75:5: You shine forth wondrously from the everlasting mountains.
verses.75:6: All the foolish of heart were troubled; they slept their sleep, and all the men of wealth found nothing in their hands.
verses.75:7: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, those who mounted the horses slumbered.
verses.75:8: You are to be feared, and who shall withstand You because of Your wrath?
verses.75:9: From heaven You hurled forth judgment; the earth feared and was still,
verses.75:10: when God arose to judgment, to save all the meek in heart. Interlude.
verses.75:11: For the thought of man shall give thanks to You, and the remnant of thought shall keep a feast to You.
verses.75:12: Make vows and pay them to the Lord our God; all who are around Him shall bring gifts
verses.75:13: to Him who is to be feared and who takes away the spirits of princes, feared among the kings of the earth.
verses.76:1: For the end, on behalf of Jeduthun; a psalm for Asaph.
verses.76:2: With my voice I cried out to the Lord, and my voice was to God, and He gave heed to me.
verses.76:3: In the day of my affliction I sought out God, with my hands by night before Him, and I was not deceived; my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.76:4: I remembered God and was gladdened; I meditated, and my spirit grew faint. Interlude.
verses.76:5: My enemies seized the watches beforehand; I was troubled and did not speak.
verses.76:6: I considered the days of old, and the everlasting years
verses.76:7: I remembered and meditated; by night I mused with my heart, and my spirit searched diligently.
verses.76:8: Will the Lord cast off forever, and will He not be well-pleased anymore?
verses.76:9: Or will He utterly cut off mercy from generation to generation?
verses.76:10: Or will God forget to have compassion, or will He hold back His compassions in His wrath? Interlude.
verses.76:11: And I said, "Now I have begun; this is the change of the right hand of the Most High."
verses.76:12: I remembered the works of the Lord, for I will remember Your wondrous works from the beginning,
verses.76:13: and I will meditate on all Your works, and I will ponder Your deeds.
verses.76:14: O God, Your way is in holiness; what god is great like our God?
verses.76:15: You are our God who works wonders; You have made known Your power among Your peoples;
verses.76:16: with Your arm You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Interlude.
verses.76:17: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and were afraid, and the depths were troubled;
verses.76:18: a multitude of the roar of water; the clouds gave forth a voice, for indeed Your arrows pass through;
verses.76:19: the voice of Your thunder was in the wheel; the earth was shaken and began to tremble.
verses.76:20: In the sea is Your way, and Your paths in many waters, and Your footprints shall not be known.
verses.76:21: You led Your people like sheep by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.77:1: Of understanding, for Asaph. Give heed, my people, to my law; incline your ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.77:2: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter riddles from the beginning,
verses.77:3: all that we have heard and known, and that our fathers have recounted to us.
verses.77:4: They were not hidden from their children to another generation, declaring the praises of the Lord and His mighty deeds, and His wondrous works that He has done.
verses.77:5: And He raised up a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to make known to their sons,
verses.77:6: that another generation might know, the sons who are to be born, and they shall arise and declare them to their sons;
verses.77:7: that they may set their hope upon God, and not forget the works of God, and shall diligently seek His commandments;
verses.77:8: that they may not become like their fathers, a crooked and provoking generation, a generation that was not upright in its heart, and whose spirit was not faithful with God.
verses.77:9: The sons of Ephraim, bending and shooting the bow, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.77:10: They did not keep the covenant of God, and were not willing to walk in His law.
verses.77:11: And they forgot His benefits and His wondrous works that He had shown them,
verses.77:12: the wondrous works that He did before their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the plain of Tanis.
verses.77:13: He split the sea and led them through; He made the waters stand like a waterskin.
verses.77:14: And He guided them with a cloud by day, and all the night with the light of fire.
verses.77:15: He split a rock in the wilderness, and gave them drink as in a great abyss;
verses.77:16: and He brought forth water out of a rock, and brought down waters like rivers.
verses.77:17: And they continued still further to sin against Him; they provoked the Most High in a waterless place,
verses.77:18: and they put God to the test in their hearts, by asking for food for their souls.
verses.77:19: And they spoke against God and said, "Will God be able to prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.77:20: Since He struck a rock, and waters flowed, and torrents overflowed, will He also be able to give bread, or prepare a table for His people?"
verses.77:21: Therefore the Lord heard and delayed, and a fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath rose up against Israel,
verses.77:22: because they did not believe in God, nor did they hope in His salvation.
verses.77:23: And He commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven;
verses.77:24: and He rained down manna for them to eat, and gave them bread of heaven.
verses.77:25: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them provisions to the full.
verses.77:26: And He raised up the south wind from heaven, and by His might He brought on the southwest wind,
verses.77:27: and He rained flesh upon them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the seas;
verses.77:28: and they fell into the midst of their camp, all around their tents.
verses.77:29: And they ate and were exceedingly filled, and He brought them their desire.
verses.77:30: They were not deprived of their desire; while still the food
verses.77:31: of theirs was in their mouth, the wrath of God rose up against them and slew among the greater part of them, and fettered the chosen ones of Israel.
verses.77:32: In all these things they sinned still more, and did not believe in
verses.77:33: His wondrous works; and their days failed in vanity, and their years with haste.
verses.77:34: Whenever He slew them, they sought Him, and they turned back and
verses.77:35: rose early to seek God; and they remembered that God is their helper, and God the Most High is their redeemer.
verses.77:36: And they loved Him with their mouth, and with their tongue
verses.77:37: they lied to Him; for their heart was not upright with Him, nor were they faithful in His covenant.
verses.77:38: Yet He is compassionate and will pardon their sins, and will not destroy; and He will many times turn away His anger, and will not kindle all His wrath.
verses.77:39: And He remembered that they are flesh, a breath passing away and not returning.
verses.77:40: How often did they provoke Him in the wilderness, and anger
verses.77:41: Him in a waterless land? And they turned back and tested God, and exasperated the Holy One of Israel.
verses.77:42: They did not remember His hand, the day when He redeemed them from the hand of the oppressor,
verses.77:43: how He set His signs in Egypt, and
verses.77:44: His wonders in the plain of Tanis; and He turned their rivers into blood, and their rainwaters so that they could not drink;
verses.77:45: He sent forth the dog-fly against them, and it devoured them, and the frog, and it destroyed them;
verses.77:46: and He gave their fruit to the blight, and their labors to the locust;
verses.77:47: He slew their vine with hail, and their sycamore trees with
verses.77:48: frost; and He delivered their cattle to hail, and their possessions to fire;
verses.77:49: He sent forth against them the wrath of His fury, fury and wrath and affliction, a sending through
verses.77:50: evil angels; He made a path for His wrath, He did not spare their souls from death, and He shut up their cattle to death;
verses.77:51: and He struck every firstborn in Egypt, the firstfruits of their labors in the tents of Ham.
verses.77:52: And He brought forth His people like sheep, and led them like
verses.77:53: a flock in the wilderness; and He guided them in hope, and they were not afraid, and the sea covered their enemies.
verses.77:54: And He brought them into the mountain of His sanctuary, this mountain which
verses.77:55: His right hand acquired; and He drove out nations from before their face, and apportioned them by a line of inheritance, and made the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.
verses.77:56: Yet they tested and provoked God the Most High, and did not keep His testimonies;
verses.77:57: and they turned back and broke covenant just like their fathers, and were turned into a crooked bow;
verses.77:58: and they angered Him upon their hills, and provoked Him to jealousy with their carved images.
verses.77:59: God heard, and disdained, and despised Israel exceedingly;
verses.77:60: and He cast off the tabernacle of Shiloh, His tent
verses.77:61: where He dwelt among men; and He delivered their strength into captivity, and His beauty into the hands of an enemy;
verses.77:62: and He shut up His people to the sword, and disdained His inheritance.
verses.77:63: Fire devoured their young men, and their virgins did not mourn;
verses.77:64: their priests fell by the sword, and their widows shall not be wept for.
verses.77:65: And the Lord awoke as one who sleeps, as a mighty man heavy-headed
verses.77:66: from wine; and He struck their enemies from behind; He gave them an everlasting reproach.
verses.77:67: And He cast off the tent of Joseph, and He did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;
verses.77:68: and He chose the tribe of Judah; Mount Zion He loved.
verses.77:69: And He built His sanctuary like that of unicorns; in the earth He founded it forever.
verses.77:70: And He chose David His servant, and took him up from the
verses.77:71: flocks of sheep; from behind the nursing ewes He took him, to shepherd Jacob His servant and Israel His inheritance.
verses.77:72: And he shepherded them in the innocence of his heart, and by the understanding of his hands he guided them.
verses.78:1: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, nations have come into Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have made Jerusalem into a fruit-watcher's hut.
verses.78:2: They have given the dead bodies of Your servants as food to the birds of heaven, the flesh of Your devout ones to the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.78:3: They have poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
verses.78:4: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those around us.
verses.78:5: How long, O Lord, will You be angry to the end? Will Your jealousy blaze like fire?
verses.78:6: Pour out Your wrath upon nations that have not known You, and upon kingdoms that have not called upon Your name.
verses.78:7: For they have devoured Jacob, and have made his place desolate.
verses.78:8: Do not remember our former iniquities; let Your tender mercies come swiftly to meet us, for we have become exceedingly poor.
verses.78:9: Help us, O God our Savior, for the sake of the glory of Your name; O Lord, deliver us, and pardon our sins for the sake of Your name.
verses.78:10: Lest they say among the nations, "Where is their God?" And let the avenging of the blood of Your servants that has been poured out be made known among the nations before our eyes.
verses.78:11: Let the groaning of the shackled come before You; according to the greatness of Your arm, preserve the sons of those put to death.
verses.78:12: Repay our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord.
verses.78:13: For we, Your people and the sheep of Your pasture, will give thanks to You forever; from generation to generation we will proclaim Your praise.
verses.79:1: For the end, concerning those who shall be changed; a testimony of Asaph, a psalm concerning the Assyrian.
verses.79:2: Give heed, O You who shepherd Israel, You who guide Joseph like sheep; You who are seated upon the cherubim, appear.
verses.79:3: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up Your mighty power, and come to save us.
verses.79:4: O God, restore us, and make Your countenance shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.79:5: O Lord God of hosts, how long will You be angry against the prayer of Your servant?
verses.79:6: Will You feed us bread of tears, and give us tears to drink by measure?
verses.79:7: You have made us a cause of strife to our neighbors, and our enemies have mocked us.
verses.79:8: O Lord God of hosts, restore us, and make Your countenance shine, and we shall be saved. Interlude.
verses.79:9: You brought a vine out of Egypt; You drove out nations and planted it.
verses.79:10: You cleared a way before it, and You planted its roots, and the land was filled.
verses.79:11: Its shadow covered mountains, and its climbing boughs the cedars of God.
verses.79:12: It stretched out its branches to the sea, and its shoots to the river.
verses.79:13: Why have You broken down its hedge, so that all who pass along the way pluck its fruit?
verses.79:14: A boar from the forest has ravaged it, and a wild donkey has grazed upon it.
verses.79:15: O God of hosts, turn back now; look down from heaven and behold, and visit this vine,
verses.79:16: and restore that which Your right hand has planted, and look upon the son of man whom You have made strong for Yourself.
verses.79:17: It is burned with fire and dug up; at the rebuke of Your countenance they shall perish.
verses.79:18: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, and upon the son of man whom You have made strong for Yourself;
verses.79:19: and we will never turn away from You; You will give us life, and we will call upon Your name.
verses.79:20: O Lord God of hosts, restore us, and make Your countenance shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.80:1: For the end, concerning the winepresses; a psalm of Asaph.
verses.80:2: Rejoice greatly in God our helper; shout aloud to the God of Jacob.
verses.80:3: Take up a psalm and sound the timbrel, the pleasant psaltery with the harp.
verses.80:4: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, on the notable day of our feast.
verses.80:5: For it is a statute for Israel, and an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.80:6: He established it as a testimony in Joseph, when he went forth out of the land of Egypt; he heard a tongue that he did not know.
verses.80:7: He removed his back from burdens; his hands served at the basket.
verses.80:8: "In affliction you called upon Me, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of the storm; I tested you at the water of Contradiction." Interlude.
verses.80:9: "Hear, O My people, and I will speak to you; O Israel, and I will solemnly testify to you. If you listen to Me,
verses.80:10: there shall be no new god among you, nor shall you worship a foreign god.
verses.80:11: For I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.80:12: Yet My people did not listen to My voice, and Israel did not give heed to Me.
verses.80:13: So I sent them away according to the practices of their hearts; they shall walk in their own practices.
verses.80:14: If the people, Israel, had listened to Me, if they had walked in My ways,
verses.80:15: in a moment I would have humbled their enemies, and upon those who afflict them I would have laid My hand."
verses.80:16: The enemies of the Lord lied to Him, and their time shall be forever.
verses.80:17: And He fed them from the choicest of wheat, and with honey from the rock He satisfied them.
verses.81:1: A Psalm of Asaph. God has taken His stand in the assembly of gods, and in the midst He judges the gods.
verses.81:2: How long will you judge unrighteousness and show partiality to sinners? Interlude.
verses.81:3: Do justice for the orphan and the poor; vindicate the humble and the needy.
verses.81:4: Rescue the needy and the poor; deliver them from the hand of the sinner.
verses.81:5: They did not know, nor did they understand; they walk on in darkness; all the foundations of the earth shall be shaken.
verses.81:6: I said, "You are gods, and all of you are sons of the Most High."
verses.81:7: Yet indeed you die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.81:8: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for You shall inherit among all the nations.
verses.82:1: A Song of a Psalm of Asaph.
verses.82:2: O God, who shall be likened to You? Do not keep silent, nor remain still, O God.
verses.82:3: For behold, Your enemies have made an uproar, and those who hate You have lifted up their head.
verses.82:4: Against Your people they have craftily devised a plan, and they have taken counsel against Your holy ones.
verses.82:5: They said, "Come, and let us utterly destroy them from being a nation, and the name of Israel shall never again be remembered."
verses.82:6: For they have taken counsel together with one accord; against You they have made a covenant:
verses.82:7: the tents of the Edomites and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
verses.82:8: Naibal and Ammon and Amalek, and foreigners with the inhabitants of Tyre.
verses.82:9: For Assyria also has joined with them; they have become a help to the sons of Lot. Interlude.
verses.82:10: Do to them as to Midian and to Sisera, as to Jabin at the brook Kishon.
verses.82:11: They were utterly destroyed at Endor; they became like dung for the earth.
verses.82:12: Make their princes like Oreb and Zeeb, and Zebah and Zalmunna—all their princes,
verses.82:13: who said, "Let us inherit for ourselves the altar of God."
verses.82:14: O my God, make them like a wheel, like stubble before the face of the wind.
verses.82:15: As fire that shall burn up a forest, as if a flame should consume mountains,
verses.82:16: so You shall pursue them in Your tempest, and in Your wrath You shall trouble them.
verses.82:17: Fill their faces with dishonor, and they shall seek Your name, O Lord.
verses.82:18: Let them be put to shame and troubled forever and ever, and let them be disgraced and perish.
verses.82:19: And let them know that Your name is the Lord—You alone are Most High over all the earth.
verses.83:1: For the end, concerning the winepresses; a Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.83:2: How beloved are Your dwellings, O Lord of hosts!
verses.83:3: My soul yearns and faints for the courts of the Lord; my heart and my flesh have rejoiced in the living God.
verses.83:4: For indeed the sparrow has found a house for itself, and the turtledove a nest for herself, where she shall lay her young—Your altars, O Lord of hosts, my King and my God.
verses.83:5: Blessed are all who dwell in Your house; forever and ever they shall praise You. Interlude.
verses.83:6: Blessed is the man whose help is from You, O Lord; he has set ascents in his heart,
verses.83:7: in the valley of weeping, to the place which he has appointed. For indeed the Lawgiver shall give blessings;
verses.83:8: they shall go from strength to strength; the God of gods shall be seen in Zion.
verses.83:9: O Lord, the God of hosts, listen to my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Interlude.
verses.83:10: See, O God our defender, and look upon the face of Your anointed.
verses.83:11: For one day in Your courts is better than thousands; I have chosen to be cast aside in the house of God rather than to dwell in the tents of sinners.
verses.83:12: For the Lord God loves mercy and truth; He shall give grace and glory; the Lord shall not withhold good things from those who walk in innocence.
verses.83:13: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man who hopes in You.
verses.84:1: For the end; a psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.84:2: You have been well pleased with Your land, O Lord; You have turned back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.84:3: You have forgiven the iniquities of Your people; You have covered their sins. Interlude.
verses.84:4: You have caused Your wrath to cease; You have turned back from the wrath of Your indignation.
verses.84:5: Turn us back, O God of our salvation, and turn Your indignation away from us.
verses.84:6: Will You be angry with us forever? Or will You prolong Your wrath from generation to generation?
verses.84:7: O God, You will turn and give us life, and Your people shall rejoice in You.
verses.84:8: Show us Your mercy, O Lord, and may You grant us Your salvation, O Lord.
verses.84:9: I will hear what the Lord God will speak within me, for He will speak peace to His people and to His holy ones, and to those who turn their heart toward Him.
verses.84:10: Indeed, His salvation is near to those who fear Him, so that glory may abide in our land.
verses.84:11: Mercy and truth met one another; righteousness and peace kissed each other.
verses.84:12: Truth has sprung forth from the earth, and righteousness has looked down from heaven.
verses.84:13: For the Lord indeed will give goodness, and our land shall yield its fruit.
verses.84:14: Righteousness shall go before Him, and shall set His footsteps upon the way.
verses.85:1: A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear me, because I am poor and needy.
verses.85:2: Guard my soul, for I am devout; save Your servant, O my God, who hopes in You.
verses.85:3: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I will cry out to You all the day.
verses.85:4: Gladden the soul of Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
verses.85:5: For You, O Lord, are good and gentle, and rich in mercy toward all who call upon You.
verses.85:6: Listen, O Lord, to my prayer, and give heed to the voice of my supplication.
verses.85:7: In the day of my affliction I cried out to You, for You heard me.
verses.85:8: There is none like You among the gods, O Lord, nor is there anything like Your works.
verses.85:9: All the nations, as many as You have made, shall come and worship before You, O Lord, and they shall glorify Your name;
verses.85:10: for You are great and work wonders; You alone are the great God.
verses.85:11: Guide me, O Lord, in Your way, and I will walk in Your truth; let my heart rejoice to fear Your name.
verses.85:12: I will give thanks to You, O Lord my God, with my whole heart, and I will glorify Your name forever;
verses.85:13: for Your mercy toward me is great, and You have rescued my soul from the lowest Hades.
verses.85:14: O God, lawless men have risen up against me, and an assembly of mighty men has sought my soul; they have not set You before them.
verses.85:15: Yet You, O Lord God, are compassionate and merciful, longsuffering, abundant in mercy, and true.
verses.85:16: Look upon me and have mercy on me; give Your might to Your servant, and save the son of Your handmaid.
verses.85:17: Work a sign with me for good, and let those who hate me see it and be put to shame, because You, O Lord, have helped me and comforted me.
verses.86:1: For the sons of Korah; a psalm of a song. His foundations are in the holy mountains.
verses.86:2: The Lord loves the gates of Zion above all the tabernacles of Jacob.
verses.86:3: Glorious things have been spoken concerning you, O city of God. Interlude.
verses.86:4: "I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know Me; and behold, foreigners and Tyre and the people of the Ethiopians—these were born there."
verses.86:5: "Mother Zion," a man shall say, and a Man was born in her, and He Himself, the Most High, has founded her.
verses.86:6: The Lord shall recount in the register of peoples and of princes—of these who have been born in her. Interlude.
verses.86:7: As of all who rejoice, the dwelling is in you.
verses.87:1: A song of a psalm for the sons of Korah; for the end, concerning Mahalath, to answer; of understanding, for Heman the Israelite.
verses.87:2: O Lord, God of my salvation, by day I have cried out, and in the night before You.
verses.87:3: Let my prayer enter before You; incline Your ear to my supplication, O Lord.
verses.87:4: For my soul has been filled with evils, and my life has drawn near to Hades.
verses.87:5: I have been reckoned with those who descend into the pit; I have become like a man without help,
verses.87:6: free among the dead, like wounded men cast away, sleeping in the tomb, whom You remembered no longer, and they were thrust away from Your hand.
verses.87:7: They have placed me in the lowest pit, in dark places and in the shadow of death.
verses.87:8: Your wrath has rested heavily upon me, and You have brought all Your surging waves upon me. Interlude.
verses.87:9: You have put my acquaintances far from me; they have made me an abomination to themselves; I was delivered up, and I did not go forth.
verses.87:10: My eyes have grown weak from poverty; and I have cried out to You, O Lord, all the day; I have stretched out my hands.
verses.87:11: Will You perform wonders for the dead? Or will physicians raise them up, and will they give praise to You?
verses.87:12: Will anyone recount Your mercy in the tomb, and Your truth in destruction?
verses.87:13: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in a forgotten land?
verses.87:14: And I, O Lord, have cried out to You, and in the morning my prayer shall come before You.
verses.87:15: Why, O Lord, do You cast off my prayer, and turn away Your face from me?
verses.87:16: I am poor and in toils from my youth; yet having been lifted up, I was humbled and brought to despair.
verses.87:17: Your outbursts of wrath have passed over me, and Your terrors have troubled me.
verses.87:18: They surrounded me like water all the day; they encompassed me altogether.
verses.87:19: You have put a friend far from me, and my acquaintances because of misery.
verses.88:1: Of understanding, for Ethan the Israelite.
verses.88:2: I will sing of Your mercies, O Lord, forever; from generation to generation I will declare Your truth with my mouth.
verses.88:3: For You said, "Mercy shall be built up forever"; in the heavens Your truth shall be established.
verses.88:4: "I have made a covenant with My chosen ones; I have sworn to David My servant,
verses.88:5: 'Forever I will establish your seed, and I will build up your throne from generation to generation.'" Interlude.
verses.88:6: The heavens shall praise Your wonders, O Lord, and Your truth in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.88:7: For who in the clouds shall be equaled to the Lord? And who shall be likened to the Lord among the sons of God?
verses.88:8: God is glorified in the council of the holy ones, great and awesome above all those who are around Him.
verses.88:9: O Lord, God of hosts, who is like You? Mighty are You, O Lord, and Your truth is all around You.
verses.88:10: You rule over the might of the sea, and You calm the surging of its waves.
