verses.88:11: You humbled the proud one like a wounded man, and with the arm of Your power You scattered Your enemies.
verses.88:12: Yours are the heavens, and Yours is the earth; You have founded the inhabited world and its fullness.
verses.88:13: You created the north and the seas; Tabor and Hermonim shall rejoice greatly in Your name.
verses.88:14: Yours is the arm with sovereign might; let Your hand be strengthened; let Your right hand be exalted.
verses.88:15: Righteousness and judgment are the foundation of Your throne; mercy and truth shall go before Your face.
verses.88:16: Blessed is the people that knows the joyful shout; O Lord, they shall walk in the light of Your countenance,
verses.88:17: and in Your name they shall rejoice all the day, and in Your righteousness they shall be exalted.
verses.88:18: For You are the boast of their strength, and in Your good pleasure our horn shall be exalted.
verses.88:19: For protection belongs to the Lord, and to the Holy One of Israel, our King.
verses.88:20: Then You spoke in a vision to Your sons and said, "I have laid help upon a mighty one; I have exalted a chosen one out of My people.
verses.88:21: I have found David My servant; with holy mercy I have anointed him.
verses.88:22: For My hand shall assist him, and My arm shall strengthen him.
verses.88:23: No enemy shall gain advantage over him, and no son of lawlessness shall again afflict him.
verses.88:24: And I will cut down his enemies from before his face, and I will put to flight those who hate him.
verses.88:25: And My truth and My mercy shall be with him, and in My name his horn shall be exalted.
verses.88:26: And I will set his hand upon the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
verses.88:27: He shall call upon Me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the Protector of my salvation.'
verses.88:28: And I will appoint him firstborn, high above the kings of the earth.
verses.88:29: Forever I will keep My mercy for him, and My covenant shall remain faithful to him.
verses.88:30: And I will establish his seed forever and ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.88:31: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
verses.88:32: if they profane My ordinances and do not keep My commandments,
verses.88:33: I will visit their iniquities with a rod, and their sins with scourges.
verses.88:34: Yet My mercy I will by no means disperse from him, nor will I deal falsely in My truth,
verses.88:35: nor will I profane My covenant, and what goes forth through My lips I will by no means set aside.
verses.88:36: Once I have sworn by My holiness—I will by no means lie to David:
verses.88:37: His seed shall abide forever, and his throne as the sun before Me,
verses.88:38: and as the moon established forever; and the witness in heaven is faithful." Interlude.
verses.88:39: But You have cast off and despised, You have put off Your anointed one.
verses.88:40: You have overturned the covenant of Your servant; You have profaned his sanctuary to the ground.
verses.88:41: You have pulled down all his enclosures; You have turned his strongholds into terror.
verses.88:42: All who pass along the way have plundered him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.88:43: You have exalted the right hand of his enemies; You have caused all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.88:44: You have turned back the help of his sword, and You did not uphold him in battle.
verses.88:45: You have removed him from purification; You have dashed his throne down to the ground.
verses.88:46: You have shortened the days of his throne; You have poured shame upon him. Interlude.
verses.88:47: How long, O Lord, will You turn away forever? Shall Your wrath burn like fire?
verses.88:48: Remember what my substance is; for have You created all the sons of men in vain?
verses.88:49: Who is the man who shall live and shall not see death? Shall he deliver his soul from the hand of Hades? Interlude.
verses.88:50: Where are Your ancient mercies, O Lord, which You swore to David in Your truth?
verses.88:51: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which You sustained in my bosom from many nations,
verses.88:52: with which Your enemies have reproached, O Lord, with which they have reproached the recompense of Your anointed one.
verses.88:53: Blessed is the Lord forever. So be it, so be it.
verses.89:1: A Prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, You have become a refuge for us from generation to generation.
verses.89:2: Before the mountains came into being, and the earth and the inhabited world were formed, even from eternity to eternity, You are.
verses.89:3: Do not turn man back to lowliness, and have You said, "Return, O sons of men"?
verses.89:4: For a thousand years in Your eyes are like yesterday, the day that has passed by, and like a watch in the night.
verses.89:5: Their worthless things shall be years; in the morning may they pass away like green grass.
verses.89:6: In the morning may they bloom and pass away; in the evening may they fall away, become hardened, and wither.
verses.89:7: For we have wasted away in Your wrath, and in Your fury we have been dismayed.
verses.89:8: You have placed our iniquities in Your presence, our lifetime in the illumination of Your countenance.
verses.89:9: For all our days have faded away, and in Your wrath we have wasted away; our years were occupied as with a spider's web.
verses.89:10: The days of our years in years are seventy years, and if in strength, eighty years, and the greater part of them is toil and pain; for gentleness has come upon us, and we shall be disciplined.
verses.89:11: Who knows the might of Your wrath, and from the fear of Your fury to reckon it up?
verses.89:12: Make known Your right hand, and those who are disciplined in heart in wisdom.
verses.89:13: Turn back, O Lord! How long? And be comforted concerning Your servants.
verses.89:14: We were filled in the morning with Your mercy, and we exulted and were glad in all our days,
verses.89:15: in return for the days in which You humbled us, the years in which we saw evils.
verses.89:16: And look upon Your servants and Your works, and guide their sons.
verses.89:17: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct the works of our hands upon us.
verses.90:1: A Praise of a Song, of David. He who dwells in the help of the Most High shall abide in the shelter of the God of heaven.
verses.90:2: He shall say to God, "You are my protector; and my refuge is my God, I will hope in Him."
verses.90:3: For He Himself shall bring deliverance from the snare of hunters, and from a troubling word.
verses.90:4: With His shoulders He shall overshadow you, and under His wings you shall hope; with a shield His truth shall surround you.
verses.90:5: You shall not fear the dread of night, nor an arrow flying by day,
verses.90:6: nor a thing passing through in darkness, nor calamity and a noonday demon.
verses.90:7: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, yet it shall not draw near to you.
verses.90:8: Only with your eyes shall you observe, and you shall behold the recompense of sinners.
verses.90:9: For You, O Lord, are my hope; you have set the Most High as your refuge.
verses.90:10: Evils shall not approach you, and a scourge shall not draw near to your tent.
verses.90:11: For He shall command His angels concerning you, to guard you carefully in your ways.
verses.90:12: Upon their hands they shall lift you up, lest at any time you strike your foot against a stone.
verses.90:13: Upon the asp and the basilisk you shall tread, and you shall trample underfoot the lion and the dragon.
verses.90:14: "Because he has hoped in Me, I will deliver him; I will shelter him, because he has known My name.
verses.90:15: He shall call upon Me, and I will hear him; I am with him in affliction, and I will rescue and glorify him.
verses.90:16: With length of days I will fill him, and I will show him My salvation."
verses.91:1: A Psalm of a Song, for the day of the Sabbath.
verses.91:2: It is a good thing to give thanks to the Lord, and to sing psalms to Your name, O Most High,
verses.91:3: to proclaim Your mercy in the morning, and Your truth by night,
verses.91:4: upon a ten-stringed psaltery, with song upon the lyre.
verses.91:5: For You have made me glad, O Lord, in Your handiwork, and in the works of Your hands I will exult.
verses.91:6: How magnified are Your works, O Lord! Exceedingly weighty are Your thoughts.
verses.91:7: A foolish man shall not know, and one without understanding shall not understand these things.
verses.91:8: When sinners spring up like grass, and all who work iniquity have peered forth, it is so that they may be utterly destroyed forever and ever.
verses.91:9: But You are Most High forever, O Lord.
verses.91:10: For behold, Your enemies shall perish, and all who work iniquity shall be scattered abroad.
verses.91:11: And my horn shall be exalted like that of a unicorn, and my old age shall be in rich oil.
verses.91:12: And my eye has looked upon my enemies, and my ear shall hear concerning the evildoers who rise up against me.
verses.91:13: A righteous man shall blossom like a palm tree; like the cedar that is in Lebanon he shall be multiplied.
verses.91:14: Planted in the house of the Lord, they shall blossom forth in the courts of our God;
verses.91:15: then they shall be multiplied in a rich old age, and they shall be thriving,
verses.91:16: to proclaim that the Lord my God is upright, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
verses.92:1: For the day before the Sabbath, when the earth was settled; a song of praise of David. The Lord reigns; He has clothed Himself with splendor; the Lord has clothed Himself with power and girded Himself; for indeed He has firmly established the inhabited world, which shall not be shaken.
verses.92:2: Your throne is prepared from of old; from everlasting You are.
verses.92:3: The rivers have lifted up, O Lord, the rivers have lifted up their voices.
verses.92:4: More than the voices of many waters, wondrous are the surges of the sea; wondrous in the heights is the Lord.
verses.92:5: Your testimonies have been proven exceedingly sure; holiness befits Your house, O Lord, for length of days.
verses.93:1: A Psalm of David, for the fourth day of the week. The Lord is the God of vengeance; the God of vengeance has revealed Himself boldly.
verses.93:2: Be exalted, O You who judge the earth; render recompense to the proud.
verses.93:3: How long shall sinners, O Lord, how long shall sinners boast?
verses.93:4: Shall they utter and speak unrighteousness; shall all who work lawlessness speak?
verses.93:5: Your people, O Lord, they have humbled, and Your inheritance they have afflicted;
verses.93:6: the widow and the orphan they have slain, and the sojourner they have murdered;
verses.93:7: and they said, "The Lord will not see, nor will the God of Jacob understand."
verses.93:8: Understand now, you senseless ones among the people; and you fools, at last be wise.
verses.93:9: He who planted the ear, does He not hear? Or He who formed the eyes, does He not discern?
verses.93:10: He who disciplines the nations, shall He not reprove—He who teaches man knowledge?
verses.93:11: The Lord knows the reasonings of men, that they are vain.
verses.93:12: Blessed is the man whom You discipline, O Lord, and teach from Your law,
verses.93:13: to grant him calm from evil days, until a pit is dug for the sinner.
verses.93:14: For the Lord will not reject His people, and His inheritance He will not abandon,
verses.93:15: until righteousness returns to judgment, and holding fast to it are all the upright in heart. Interlude.
verses.93:16: Who will rise up for me against evildoers, or who will stand beside me against those who work lawlessness?
verses.93:17: Unless the Lord had helped me, my soul would nearly have dwelt in Hades.
verses.93:18: If I said, "My foot has been shaken," Your mercy, O Lord, helps me.
verses.93:19: O Lord, according to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, Your consolations have loved my soul.
verses.93:20: Shall a throne of lawlessness be joined with You, which fashions trouble by a decree?
verses.93:21: They will hunt for the soul of the righteous, and they will condemn innocent blood.
verses.93:22: And the Lord has become a refuge for me, and my God the helper of my hope;
verses.93:23: and He will repay to them their lawlessness and their wickedness; the Lord our God will utterly destroy them.
verses.94:1: A song of praise of David. Come, let us exult to the Lord; let us shout joyfully to God our Savior;
verses.94:2: let us come before His face with thanksgiving, and with psalms let us shout joyfully to Him.
verses.94:3: For a great God is the Lord, and a great King over all the gods.
verses.94:4: For the Lord will not reject His people, because in His hand are the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are His;
verses.94:5: for His is the sea, and He Himself made it, and His hands fashioned the dry land.
verses.94:6: Come, let us worship and fall down before Him, and let us weep before the Lord who made us;
verses.94:7: for He Himself is our God, and we are a people of His pasture and sheep of His hand.
verses.94:8: Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts as in the provocation, according to the day of testing in the wilderness,
verses.94:9: where your fathers tested, proved, and saw My works.
verses.94:10: Forty years I was indignant with that generation, and I said, "They always go astray in their heart, and they themselves have not known My ways."
verses.94:11: So I swore in My wrath, "They shall surely not enter into My rest."
verses.95:1: When the house is being built after the captivity; a song of David. Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.95:2: Sing to the Lord, bless His name; proclaim the good tidings of His salvation day by day.
verses.95:3: Announce His glory among the nations, His wondrous deeds among all the peoples.
verses.95:4: For great is the Lord and exceedingly to be praised; He is to be feared above all the gods.
verses.95:5: For all the gods of the nations are demons, but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.95:6: Thanksgiving and beauty are before Him; holiness and magnificence are in His sanctuary.
verses.95:7: Bring to the Lord, O families of the nations, bring to the Lord glory and honor.
verses.95:8: Bring to the Lord glory for His name; take up sacrifices and enter into His courts.
verses.95:9: Worship the Lord in His holy court; let all the earth be shaken before His presence.
verses.95:10: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns; indeed, He has firmly established the world, which shall not be shaken; He shall judge peoples in uprightness."
verses.95:11: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth exult; let the sea be shaken, and its fullness.
verses.95:12: The plains shall rejoice, and all things that are in them; then all the trees of the forest shall exult
verses.95:13: before the presence of the Lord, for He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth; He shall judge the world in righteousness, and peoples in His truth.
verses.96:1: Of David, when his land is being established. The Lord reigns; the earth shall exult; let many isles be glad.
verses.96:2: Cloud and thick darkness are around Him; righteousness and judgment are the firm establishment of His throne.
verses.96:3: Fire shall go before Him, and shall set His enemies aflame on every side.
verses.96:4: His lightnings shone upon the world; the earth saw and was shaken.
verses.96:5: The mountains melted like wax before the presence of the Lord, before the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
verses.96:6: The heavens announced His righteousness, and all the peoples saw His glory.
verses.96:7: Let all be put to shame who worship carved images, who boast in their idols; worship Him, all His angels.
verses.96:8: Zion heard and was glad, and the daughters of Judea exulted, because of Your judgments, O Lord.
verses.96:9: For You are the Lord, the Most High over all the earth; You are exceedingly exalted above all the gods.
verses.96:10: You who love the Lord, hate evil; the Lord guards the souls of His holy ones; from the hand of sinners He shall deliver them.
verses.96:11: Light has dawned for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.96:12: Be glad in the Lord, you righteous, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.97:1: A Psalm of David. Sing to the Lord a new song, for the Lord has done marvelous things; His right hand and His holy arm have brought Him salvation.
verses.97:2: The Lord has made known His salvation before the nations; He has revealed His righteousness.
verses.97:3: He has remembered His mercy toward Jacob and His truth toward the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.97:4: Shout aloud to God, all the earth; sing, exult, and make melody.
verses.97:5: Make melody to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the voice of a psalm,
verses.97:6: with hammered trumpets and the sound of a trumpet of horn; shout aloud before the King, the Lord.
verses.97:7: Let the sea be shaken, and its fullness, the world and those who dwell in it.
verses.97:8: Rivers shall clap their hands together; the mountains shall exult
verses.97:9: for He has come to judge the earth; He shall judge the world in righteousness, and peoples in uprightness.
verses.98:1: A Psalm of David. The Lord reigns; let the peoples be enraged. He who sits upon the cherubim—let the earth be shaken.
verses.98:2: Great is the Lord in Zion, and He is lofty above all the peoples.
verses.98:3: Let all give thanks to Your great name, for it is awesome and holy.
verses.98:4: And the honor of a king loves judgment; You have prepared uprightness; You have performed judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.98:5: Exalt the Lord our God, and bow down to the footstool of His feet.
verses.98:6: He is holy. Moses and Aaron were among His priests, and Samuel was among those who call upon His name; they called upon the Lord, and He Himself heard them.
verses.98:7: In a pillar of cloud He spoke to them; they kept His testimonies, and the ordinances that He gave them.
verses.98:8: O Lord our God, You heard them; O God, You were merciful to them, yet taking vengeance upon all their practices.
verses.98:9: Exalt the Lord our God, and bow down toward His holy mountain, for holy is the Lord our God.
verses.99:1: A Psalm for thanksgiving. Raise a joyful shout to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.99:2: Serve the Lord with gladness; enter into His presence with exultation.
verses.99:3: Know that the Lord—He is God; He made us, and not we ourselves, His people and the sheep of His pasture.
verses.99:4: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with hymns; give thanks to Him, praise His name.
verses.99:5: For the Lord is good; His mercy is forever, and His truth endures to generation and generation.
verses.100:1: A Psalm of David. Of mercy and judgment I will sing to You, O Lord.
verses.100:2: I will sing praises and have understanding in a blameless song; when will You come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart, in the midst of my house.
verses.100:3: I did not set before my eyes any lawless thing; I hated those who commit transgressions; a crooked heart did not cling to me.
verses.100:4: When the wicked one turned aside from me, I did not know him.
verses.100:5: The one who secretly slandered his neighbor, him I drove out; one of haughty eye and insatiable heart, with him I did not eat.
verses.100:6: My eyes were upon the faithful of the land, that they might sit with me; the one who walked in a blameless way, he ministered to me.
verses.100:7: He who practiced arrogance did not dwell in the midst of my house; he who spoke unjust things did not prosper before my eyes.
verses.100:8: Morning by morning I slew all the sinners of the land, that I might utterly destroy from the city of the Lord all who work iniquity.
verses.101:1: A prayer for the poor man, when he grows faint and pours out his supplication before the Lord.
verses.101:2: O Lord, hear my prayer, and let my outcry come to You.
verses.101:3: Do not turn Your face away from me; in whatever day I am afflicted, incline Your ear to me; in whatever day I call upon You, hear me swiftly.
verses.101:4: For my days have vanished like smoke, and my bones have been scorched like dry kindling.
verses.101:5: I have been struck down like grass, and my heart has withered, for I forgot to eat my bread.
verses.101:6: Because of the sound of my groaning, my bone has clung to my flesh.
verses.101:7: I have grown like a pelican of the wilderness; I have become as a night-raven in a ruined dwelling.
verses.101:8: I have lain awake and have become like a solitary sparrow upon a housetop.
verses.101:9: All day long my enemies reproached me, and those who praised me swore against me.
verses.101:10: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.101:11: from before Your wrath and Your indignation; for having lifted me up, You have dashed me down.
verses.101:12: My days have declined like a shadow, and I have withered away like grass.
verses.101:13: Yet You, O Lord, abide forever, and Your remembrance is from generation to generation.
verses.101:14: You shall arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show compassion to her, for the season has come.
verses.101:15: For Your servants have taken pleasure in her stones, and they shall pity her dust.
verses.101:16: And the nations shall fear Your name, O Lord, and all the kings Your glory;
verses.101:17: because the Lord will build Zion, and He will be seen in His glory.
verses.101:18: He has looked upon the prayer of the humble, and has not despised their supplication.
verses.101:19: Let this be written for another generation, and a people being created shall praise the Lord;
verses.101:20: for He has looked forth from His holy height; from heaven the Lord has gazed upon the earth,
verses.101:21: to hear the groaning of those bound in fetters, to loose the sons of those who have been put to death,
verses.101:22: to proclaim in Zion the name of the Lord, and His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.101:23: when peoples are gathered together into one, and kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
verses.101:24: He answered Him in the way of his strength, "Declare to me the fewness of my days.
verses.101:25: Do not take me away in the half of my days; Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.101:26: At the beginning You, O Lord, founded the earth, and the heavens are the works of Your hands;
verses.101:27: they shall perish, while You endure continually; and all of them shall grow old like a garment, and like a mantle You shall roll them up, and they shall be changed;
verses.101:28: yet You are the very same, and Your years shall not fail.
verses.101:29: The sons of Your servants shall have their dwelling, and their seed shall be directed aright forever."
verses.102:1: Of David. O my soul, bless the Lord, and all my inward parts, His holy name.
verses.102:2: O my soul, bless the Lord, and do not forget all His praises;
verses.102:3: who pardons all your iniquities, who heals all your sicknesses;
verses.102:4: who redeems your life from corruption, who crowns you with mercy and tender compassions,
verses.102:5: who fills your desire with good things; your youth shall be renewed like that of an eagle.
verses.102:6: The Lord performs deeds of mercy and judgment for all who suffer wrong.
verses.102:7: He made known His ways to Moses, to the sons of Israel His will.
verses.102:8: Compassionate and merciful is the Lord, longsuffering and rich in mercy.
verses.102:9: He will not remain angry to the end, nor will He hold His wrath forever;
verses.102:10: Not according to our sins has He done to us, nor according to our iniquities has He repaid us.
verses.102:11: For according to the height of heaven above the earth, the Lord has made His mercy mighty over those who fear Him;
verses.102:12: as far as the east stands distant from the west, He has put our iniquities far from us.
verses.102:13: And just as a father shows compassion to his sons, the Lord has shown compassion to those who fear Him,
verses.102:14: for He Himself knows our frame; remember that we are dust.
verses.102:15: Man—his days are like grass; like a flower of the field, thus shall he bloom.
verses.102:16: For a wind passes through him, and he shall be no more, and he shall no longer recognize his place.
verses.102:17: Yet the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting even to everlasting upon those who fear Him, and His righteousness upon sons of sons,
verses.102:18: to those who keep His covenant, and to those who are mindful of His commandments to perform them.
verses.102:19: The Lord has prepared His throne in heaven, and His kingdom holds dominion over all.
verses.102:20: Bless the Lord, all His angels, mighty in strength, who carry out His word, to heed the voice of His words.
verses.102:21: Bless the Lord, all His hosts, His ministers who perform His will.
verses.102:22: Bless the Lord, all His works, in every place of His dominion; O my soul, bless the Lord.
verses.103:1: Of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord, Lord, my God, how exceedingly You have been magnified! You have clothed Yourself with praise and splendor,
verses.103:2: wrapping Yourself in light as in a garment, stretching out the heaven like a skin curtain;
verses.103:3: who roofs His upper chambers with waters, who appoints clouds as His ascent, who walks upon wings of winds;
verses.103:4: who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a blazing fire.
verses.103:5: He founded the earth upon its stability; it shall not sway forever and ever.
verses.103:6: The abyss, like a garment, is His mantle; waters shall stand upon the mountains.
verses.103:7: At Your rebuke they shall flee; at the sound of Your thunder they shall cower in dread.
verses.103:8: Mountains ascend and plains descend to the place which You founded for them.
verses.103:9: You set a boundary which they shall not pass beyond, nor shall they turn back to cover the earth.
verses.103:10: He sends forth springs in ravines; through the midst of the mountains waters shall pass.
verses.103:11: They shall give drink to all the wild beasts of the field; wild donkeys shall await them in their thirst.
verses.103:12: Beside them the birds of heaven shall make their dwelling; from the midst of the rocks they shall sound forth their voice.
verses.103:13: He waters the mountains from His upper chambers; from the fruit of Your works the earth shall be satisfied.
verses.103:14: He causes grass to spring up for the cattle, and green herbage for the service of mankind, to bring forth bread from the earth;
verses.103:15: and wine gladdens the heart of man, to brighten his countenance with oil, and bread strengthens the heart of man.
verses.103:16: The trees of the plain shall be satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon which He planted.
verses.103:17: There sparrows shall build their nests; the dwelling of the heron leads the way for it.
verses.103:18: The high mountains are for the deer; a rock is a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.103:19: He made the moon for the seasons; the sun knows its setting.
verses.103:20: You appointed darkness, and it became night; in it all the wild beasts of the forest shall roam abroad,
verses.103:21: young lions roaring to seize their prey, and to seek food for themselves from God.
verses.103:22: The sun rises, and they shall gather together, and in their dens they shall lie down.
verses.103:23: Man shall go forth to his work, and to his labor until evening.
verses.103:24: How magnified are Your works, O Lord! All things You have made in wisdom; the earth is filled with Your creation.
verses.103:25: This is the great and spacious sea; there are creeping things without number, living creatures small and great,
verses.103:26: this dragon which You fashioned to play in it.
verses.103:27: All things wait expectantly upon You, to give them their food in due season.
verses.103:28: When You give to them, they shall gather it; and when You open Your hand, all things together shall be filled with goodness.
verses.103:29: But when You turn away Your countenance, they shall be troubled; You shall take away their spirit, and they shall expire and return to their dust.
verses.103:30: You shall send forth Your Spirit, and they shall be created; and You shall renew the face of the earth.
verses.103:31: May the glory of the Lord be forever; the Lord shall rejoice in His works;
verses.103:32: who looks upon the earth and makes it tremble, who touches the mountains and they smoke.
verses.103:33: I will sing to the Lord throughout my life; I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
verses.103:34: May my meditation be sweet to Him; as for me, I will rejoice in the Lord.
verses.103:35: May sinners vanish from the earth, and the lawless, so that they exist no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul.
verses.104:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord and call upon His name; proclaim His works among the nations.
verses.104:2: Sing to Him and sing psalms to Him; recount all His wondrous works.
verses.104:3: Exult in His holy name; let the heart of those who seek the Lord be glad.
verses.104:4: Seek the Lord and be strengthened; seek His face continually.
verses.104:5: Remember His marvelous deeds that He has done, His wonders and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.104:6: O seed of Abraham, His servants, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.104:7: He Himself is the Lord our God; His judgments are throughout all the earth.
verses.104:8: He has remembered His covenant forever, the word which He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.104:9: which He covenanted with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac,
verses.104:10: and He established it to Jacob as a statute, and to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.104:11: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the measured portion of your inheritance,"
verses.104:12: when they were small in number, very few, and sojourners in it.
verses.104:13: And they passed from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.104:14: He did not permit any man to wrong them, and He rebuked kings on their behalf:
verses.104:15: "Do not touch My anointed ones, and do not deal wickedly with My prophets."
verses.104:16: And He summoned a famine upon the land; every support of bread He broke.
verses.104:17: He sent a man ahead of them; Joseph was sold as a slave.
verses.104:18: They afflicted his feet with fetters; his soul passed through iron,
verses.104:19: until his word came to pass; the oracle of the Lord refined him by fire.
verses.104:20: The king sent and loosed him, the ruler of peoples, and set him free.
verses.104:21: He appointed him lord of his house and ruler of all his possessions,
verses.104:22: to instruct his princes as himself, and to make his elders wise.
verses.104:23: And Israel entered into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.104:24: And He increased His people exceedingly, and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.104:25: And He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal craftily with His servants.
verses.104:26: He sent forth Moses His servant, Aaron whom He had chosen.
verses.104:27: He placed among them the words of His signs and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.104:28: He sent forth darkness, and it grew dark; and they embittered His words.
verses.104:29: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.104:30: Their land swarmed forth frogs, in the inner chambers of their kingdoms.
verses.104:31: He spoke, and the dog-fly came, and gnats throughout all their borders.
verses.104:32: He made their rains into hail, a consuming fire in their land.
verses.104:33: And He struck their vines and their fig trees, and shattered every tree of their territory.
verses.104:34: He spoke, and the locust came, and the crawling locust, of which there was no number,
verses.104:35: and devoured all the herbage in their land, and devoured the fruit of their land.
verses.104:36: And He struck every firstborn from their land, the firstfruits of all their labor.
verses.104:37: And He brought them out with silver and gold, and there was none who was feeble among their tribes.
verses.104:38: Egypt was glad at their departure, for the fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.104:39: He spread out a cloud as a shelter for them, and fire to illuminate the night for them.
verses.104:40: They asked, and the quail came, and He filled them with the bread of heaven.
verses.104:41: He split the rock open, and waters flowed out; rivers ran in waterless places.
verses.104:42: For He remembered His holy word to Abraham His servant.
verses.104:43: And He brought out His people with exultation, and His chosen ones with gladness.
verses.104:44: And He gave them the territories of the nations, and they inherited the labors of the peoples,
verses.104:45: so that they might keep His ordinances and diligently seek His law.
verses.105:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy abides forever.
verses.105:2: Who shall speak of the mighty deeds of the Lord, or cause all His praises to be heard?
verses.105:3: Blessed are those who keep judgment and practice righteousness at all times.
verses.105:4: Remember us, O Lord, in the good pleasure toward Your people; visit us in Your salvation,
verses.105:5: that we may look upon the goodness of Your chosen ones, that we may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, that we may be praised together with Your inheritance.
verses.105:6: We have sinned with our fathers; we have acted lawlessly; we have done unrighteousness.
verses.105:7: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders, and did not remember the multitude of Your mercy, but rebelled bitterly as they went up at the Red Sea.
verses.105:8: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, in order to make known His might.
verses.105:9: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; and He led them in the deep as in a wilderness.
verses.105:10: And He saved them from the hands of those who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.105:11: And water covered those who afflicted them; not a single one of them remained.
verses.105:12: And they believed in His words, and praised Him with His praise.
verses.105:13: They made haste, they forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel.
verses.105:14: And they lusted with a craving in the wilderness, and put God to the test in a waterless place.
verses.105:15: And He granted them their request, and sent forth fullness into their soul.
verses.105:16: And they provoked Moses to anger in the camp, and Aaron, the holy one of the Lord.
verses.105:17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered over the assembly of Abiram.
verses.105:18: And a fire was kindled in their assembly, and a flame burned up sinners.
verses.105:19: And they made a calf at Horeb, and worshiped the carved image.
verses.105:20: And they exchanged their glory for the likeness of a calf that eats grass.
verses.105:21: They forgot God who saves them, who performed great things in Egypt,
verses.105:22: wondrous deeds in the land of Ham, and fearful things at the Red Sea.
verses.105:23: And He spoke of destroying them, had not Moses, His chosen one, stood in the breach before Him, to turn Him away from the fury of His wrath, lest He destroy them.
verses.105:24: And they despised a desirable land, and did not believe His word;
verses.105:25: and they murmured in their tents; they did not heed the voice of the Lord.
verses.105:26: And He lifted up His hand against them, to cast them down in the wilderness,
verses.105:27: and to cast down their seed among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.105:28: And they were initiated to Baal-Peor, and ate sacrifices of the dead;
verses.105:29: and they provoked Him to anger with their practices, and destruction was multiplied upon them.
verses.105:30: And Phinehas stood up and made atonement, and the plague abated.
verses.105:31: And it was reckoned to him for righteousness, to generation and generation forevermore.
verses.105:32: And they provoked wrath at the water of Contradiction, and Moses suffered ill on their account,
verses.105:33: because they embittered his spirit, and he spoke explicitly with his lips.
verses.105:34: They did not destroy the nations concerning which the Lord had spoken,
verses.105:35: but they mingled among the nations and learned their works;
verses.105:36: and they served their carved images, and it became a stumbling block to them;
verses.105:37: and they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons,
verses.105:38: and shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters; they sacrificed to the carved images of Canaan; and the land was defiled with murder by the blood,
verses.105:39: and it was defiled by their works, and they played the harlot in their practices.
verses.105:40: And the Lord was enraged with wrath against His people, and He abhorred His inheritance.
verses.105:41: And He delivered them into the hands of the nations, and those who hated them held dominion over them.
verses.105:42: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled beneath their hands.
verses.105:43: Many times He rescued them, yet they rebelled bitterly in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquities.
verses.105:44: Yet He looked upon them when they were afflicted, when He heard their supplication;
verses.105:45: and He remembered His covenant, and relented according to the multitude of His mercy,
verses.105:46: and He granted them compassion in the sight of all who had taken them captive.
verses.105:47: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us together from among the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name and glory in Your praise.
verses.105:48: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting; and all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.106:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy abides forever.
verses.106:2: Let those redeemed by the Lord speak, whom He redeemed from the hand of an enemy.
verses.106:3: From the lands He gathered them, from the east and the west, and from the north and the sea.
verses.106:4: They wandered in the wilderness in a waterless place; they did not find a way to a city of habitation.
verses.106:5: Hungering and thirsting, their soul failed within them.
verses.106:6: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He delivered them from their distresses;
verses.106:7: and He guided them into a straight way, that they might walk to a city of habitation.
verses.106:8: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies, and for His wondrous works to the sons of men,
verses.106:9: for He satisfied an empty soul, and He filled a hungry soul with good things.
verses.106:10: Those sitting in darkness and the shadow of death, bound in poverty and in iron,
verses.106:11: because they rebelled against the oracles of God, and provoked the counsel of the Most High.
verses.106:12: And their heart was humbled in labors; they grew weak, and there was no one to help.
verses.106:13: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He saved them from their distresses;
verses.106:14: and He brought them out of darkness and out of the shadow of death, and He tore their bonds apart.
verses.106:15: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies, and for His wondrous works to the sons of men,
verses.106:16: for He shattered gates of bronze, and He broke bars of iron in pieces.
verses.106:17: He helped them out of the way of their iniquity, for because of their iniquities they were humbled.
verses.106:18: Their soul loathed all food, and they drew near even to the gates of death.
verses.106:19: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He saved them from their distresses;
verses.106:20: He sent forth His word and healed them, and He delivered them from their destructions.
verses.106:21: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies, and for His wondrous works to the sons of men,
verses.106:22: and let them offer a sacrifice of praise, and proclaim His works with exultation.
verses.106:23: Those who go down to the sea in ships, carrying on their work in many waters,
verses.106:24: they themselves saw the works of the Lord, and His wondrous works in the deep.
verses.106:25: He spoke, and a tempestuous wind arose, and its waves were lifted high;
verses.106:26: they ascend to the heavens, and they descend to the depths; their soul was melting away in calamities;
verses.106:27: they were troubled and reeled like a drunken man, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
verses.106:28: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He brought them out of their distresses,
verses.106:29: and He stilled its tempest, and its waves fell silent;
verses.106:30: and they rejoiced because they grew quiet, and He guided them by the care of His will.
verses.106:31: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies, and for His wondrous works to the sons of men,
verses.106:32: let them exalt Him in the assemblies of the people, and in the seats of the elders let them praise Him.
verses.106:33: He turned rivers into a wilderness, and outlets of waters into thirst,
verses.106:34: a fruitful land into saltiness, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.106:35: He turned a wilderness into havens of waters,
verses.106:36: and there He settled the hungry, and they established a city of habitation,
verses.106:37: and they sowed fields and planted vineyards, and they yielded fruit of increase.
verses.106:38: And He blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly, and He did not diminish their cattle.
verses.106:39: And they became few and were afflicted through oppression of evils and sorrow.
verses.106:40: Contempt was poured out upon rulers, and He caused them to wander in a trackless place where there is no way.
verses.106:41: And He helped the poor man out of poverty, and He made families like sheep.
verses.106:42: The upright shall see and rejoice, and all iniquity shall shut its mouth.
verses.106:43: Who is wise and will observe these things? And they shall understand the mercies of the Lord.
verses.107:1: A song of a psalm of David.
verses.107:2: My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready; I will sing and make melody in my glory.
verses.107:3: Awake, psaltery and lyre; I will awake at dawn.
verses.107:4: I will give thanks to You among the peoples, O Lord, and I will sing praise to You among the nations;
verses.107:5: for Your mercy is great above the heavens, and Your truth reaches to the clouds.
verses.107:6: Be exalted above the heavens, O God, and let Your glory be over all the earth.
verses.107:7: That Your beloved ones may be delivered, save with Your right hand and hear me.
verses.107:8: God spoke in His sanctuary: "I will be exalted and will divide Shechem, and I will measure out the valley of tabernacles.
verses.107:9: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine, and Ephraim is the support of My head; Judah is My king;
verses.107:10: Moab is the basin of My hope; upon Idumea I will stretch out My sandal; to Me the foreigners have been subjected."
verses.107:11: Who will bring me into a fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Idumea?
verses.107:12: Is it not You, O God, who cast us off? And will You not go forth, O God, with our armies?
verses.107:13: Give us help out of affliction, and vain is the salvation of man.
verses.107:14: In God we shall act mightily, and He Himself shall bring our enemies to nothing.
verses.108:1: To the end; a psalm of David. O God, do not pass over my praise in silence,
verses.108:2: for the mouth of a sinner and the mouth of a deceitful man have been opened against me; they have spoken against me with a deceitful tongue;
verses.108:3: and with words of hatred they surrounded me, and fought against me without cause.
verses.108:4: Instead of loving me, they slandered me, yet I kept praying;
verses.108:5: and they set evil against me in return for good, and hatred in return for my love.
verses.108:6: Appoint a sinner over him, and let an accuser stand at his right hand;
verses.108:7: when he is judged, may he go forth condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
verses.108:8: Let his days be few, and may another receive his office;
verses.108:9: let his sons become orphans, and his wife a widow;
verses.108:10: tossed about, let his sons wander and beg; let them be cast out from their ruined dwellings.
verses.108:11: And let a creditor search out all that belongs to him; let strangers plunder all his labors;
verses.108:12: let there be no helper for him, nor let there be anyone compassionate to his orphans;
verses.108:13: let his children be given over to utter destruction; in one generation let his name be blotted out.
verses.108:14: May the sin of his fathers be remembered before the Lord, and may the sin of his mother not be blotted out;
verses.108:15: let them be before the Lord continually, and may their memorial be utterly destroyed from the earth.
verses.108:16: Because he did not remember to show mercy, and pursued the needy and the poor and the one pierced in heart, to put him to death.
verses.108:17: And he loved a curse, and it shall come to him; and he did not desire blessing, and it shall be far removed from him.
verses.108:18: And he clothed himself with a curse as with a garment, and it entered like water into his inward parts and like oil into his bones;
verses.108:19: let it be to him like a garment that he wraps around himself, and like a belt with which he girds himself continually.
verses.108:20: This is the work of those who slander me before the Lord, and of those who speak evil against my soul.
verses.108:21: Yet You, O Lord, Lord, show mercy to me for the sake of Your name, for Your mercy is good;
verses.108:22: deliver me; for I am poor and needy, and my heart is troubled within me.
verses.108:23: As a shadow, when it declines, is taken away, I was shaken off like locusts.
verses.108:24: My knees have grown weak from fasting, and my flesh has been altered because of oil.
verses.108:25: And I became a reproach to them; they saw me, they shook their heads.
verses.108:26: Help me, O Lord my God; save me according to Your great mercy;
verses.108:27: and let them know that this is Your hand, and that You, O Lord, have done it.
verses.108:28: They will curse, but You will bless; let those who rise up against me be put to shame, while Your servant shall rejoice.
verses.108:29: Let those who slander me be clothed with disgrace, and let them wrap themselves with shame as with their cloak.
verses.108:30: I will give thanks to the Lord greatly with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise Him;
verses.108:31: for He has stood at the right hand of the needy, to save me from those who pursue my soul.
verses.109:1: A psalm of David. The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand until I set Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet."
verses.109:2: The Lord shall send forth a scepter of power from Zion; and have dominion in the midst of Your enemies.
verses.109:3: With You is dominion in the day of Your power, in the splendor of the holy ones; from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten You.
verses.109:4: The Lord has sworn and will not change His mind: "You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.109:5: The Lord at Your right hand has shattered kings in the day of His wrath;
verses.109:6: He shall judge among the nations, He shall heap up corpses, He shall shatter heads across a vast earth.
verses.109:7: He shall drink from a brook along the way; therefore He shall lift up His head.
verses.110:1: Hallelujah. I will give thanks to You, O Lord, with all my heart, in the council of the upright and in the congregation.
verses.110:2: Great are the works of the Lord, sought out according to all His desires;
verses.110:3: Thanksgiving and majesty are His work, and His righteousness abides forever and ever.
verses.110:4: He has made a memorial of His wondrous works; merciful and compassionate is the Lord.
verses.110:5: He has given food to those who fear Him; He shall remember His covenant forever.
verses.110:6: He has declared the might of His works to His people, to give them the inheritance of the nations.
verses.110:7: The works of His hands are truth and judgment; all His commandments are faithful,
verses.110:8: established forever and ever, made in truth and uprightness.
verses.110:9: He has sent redemption to His people; He has commanded His covenant forever; holy and awe-inspiring is His name.
verses.110:10: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord; good understanding belongs to all who practice it; His praise abides forever and ever.
verses.111:1: Hallelujah. Blessed is the man who fears the Lord; in His commandments he delights exceedingly.
verses.111:2: Mighty in the earth shall his seed be; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.111:3: Glory and wealth are in his house, and his righteousness abides forever and ever.
verses.111:4: Light has dawned in darkness for the upright; he is merciful, and compassionate, and righteous.
verses.111:5: Good is the man who shows compassion and lends; he shall order his words with judgment.
verses.111:6: For he shall never be shaken; the righteous shall be held in eternal remembrance.
verses.111:7: He shall not be afraid of an evil report; his heart is prepared to hope in the Lord.
verses.111:8: His heart is firmly established; he shall not fear until he looks upon his enemies.
verses.111:9: He has scattered abroad, he has given to the needy; his righteousness abides forever and ever; his horn shall be exalted in glory.
verses.111:10: A sinner shall see it and be angered; he shall gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of sinners shall perish.
verses.112:1: Hallelujah. Praise the Lord, O servants; praise His name.
verses.112:2: May the name of the Lord be blessed from this time onward and forevermore.
verses.112:3: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the name of the Lord is praised.
verses.112:4: High above all the nations is the Lord; above the heavens is His glory.
verses.112:5: Who is like the Lord our God, who dwells in the heights,
verses.112:6: and looks upon the lowly things in heaven and on the earth?
verses.112:7: He raises the poor from the earth, and lifts up the needy from the dunghill,
verses.112:8: to seat him with rulers, with the rulers of His people.
verses.112:9: He causes the barren woman to dwell in a home, a mother of rejoicing children.
verses.113:1: Hallelujah. When Israel went forth out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a foreign-speaking people,
verses.113:2: Judea became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
verses.113:3: The sea beheld and fled; the Jordan was turned backward.
verses.113:4: The mountains leaped like rams, and the hills like lambs of the flock.
verses.113:5: What is it, O sea, that you fled? And you, O Jordan, that you retreated backward?
verses.113:6: O mountains, did you leap like rams?
verses.113:7: At the presence of the Lord the earth was shaken, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.113:8: who turned the rock into pools of water, and the flinty rock into springs of water.
verses.113:9: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to Your name give glory, because of Your mercy and Your truth.
verses.113:10: Lest the nations ever say, "Where is their God?"
verses.113:11: But our God is in heaven above; in the heavens and upon the earth He has done all that He willed.
verses.113:12: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the works of the hands of men.
verses.113:13: They have a mouth, and they do not speak; they have eyes, and they shall not see.
verses.113:14: They have ears, and they shall not hear; they have noses, and they shall not smell.
verses.113:15: They have hands, and they shall not feel; they have feet, and they shall not walk; they shall not utter a sound through their throat.
verses.113:16: May those who make them become like them, and all who put their trust in them.
verses.113:17: The house of Israel has hoped in the Lord; He is their helper and their defender.
verses.113:18: The house of Aaron has hoped in the Lord; He is their helper and their defender.
verses.113:19: Those who fear the Lord have hoped in Him; He is their helper and their defender.
verses.113:20: The Lord has remembered us and blessed us; He has blessed the house of Israel; He has blessed the house of Aaron.
verses.113:21: He has blessed those who fear the Lord, the small together with the great.
verses.113:22: May the Lord grant increase upon you, upon you and upon your sons.
verses.113:23: You are blessed by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.113:24: The heaven of heaven belongs to the Lord, but the earth He has given to the sons of men.
verses.113:25: The dead shall not praise You, O Lord, nor any who go down into Hades,
verses.113:26: but let us who live bless the Lord from this time onward and forevermore.
verses.114:1: Hallelujah. I have loved, because God will hear the voice of my supplication,
verses.114:2: because He inclined His ear to me, and in His days I called out.
verses.114:3: The pangs of death encompassed me, the perils of Hades found me; I found affliction and sorrow.
verses.114:4: And I called upon the name of the Lord: "O Lord, deliver my soul."
verses.114:5: Merciful and righteous is the Lord, and the Lord our God shows mercy.
verses.114:6: The Lord guards the little ones; I was brought low, and He saved me.
verses.114:7: Return, my soul, to your rest, because the Lord has done good to you;
verses.114:8: because He rescued my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from slipping.
verses.114:9: I will be well-pleasing before the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.115:1: Hallelujah. I believed, therefore I spoke; yet I was brought exceedingly low.
verses.115:2: I said in my dismay, "Every man is a liar."
verses.115:3: What shall I render to the Lord for what He has rendered to me?
verses.115:4: I will receive the cup of salvation, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.115:6: Precious before the Lord is the death of His holy ones.
verses.115:7: O Lord, I am Your servant; I am Your servant and the son of Your maidservant; You have burst my bonds.
verses.115:8: To You I will offer a sacrifice of praise;
verses.115:9: my vows I will pay to the Lord before all His people,
verses.115:10: in the courts of the house of the Lord, in your midst, O Jerusalem.
verses.116:1: Hallelujah. Praise the Lord, all you nations; let all the peoples praise Him;
verses.116:2: for His mercy has grown mighty upon us, and the truth of the Lord abides forever.
verses.117:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy abides forever.
verses.117:2: Let the house of Israel now say that He is good, that His mercy abides forever;
verses.117:3: let the house of Aaron now say that He is good, that His mercy abides forever.
verses.117:4: Let all those who fear the Lord now say that He is good, that His mercy abides forever.
verses.117:5: In affliction I called upon the Lord, and He heard me, bringing me into a broad place.
verses.117:6: The Lord is a helper to me; I shall not be afraid. What will man do to me?
verses.117:7: The Lord is a helper to me, and I shall look upon my enemies.
verses.117:8: It is better to put confidence in the Lord than to put confidence in man;
verses.117:9: it is better to hope in the Lord than to hope in rulers.
verses.117:10: All the nations surrounded me, and by the name of the Lord I repelled them;
verses.117:11: surrounding, they surrounded me, and by the name of the Lord I repelled them;
verses.117:12: they surrounded me like bees around a honeycomb, and they blazed up like fire among thorns; and by the name of the Lord I repelled them.
verses.117:13: Having been pushed, I was overturned so as to fall, and the Lord upheld me.
verses.117:14: My strength and my song of praise is the Lord, and He has become salvation to me.
verses.117:15: The voice of exultation and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; the right hand of the Lord has acted mightily,
verses.117:16: the right hand of the Lord has exalted me.
verses.117:17: I shall not die, but I shall live, and I shall recount the works of the Lord.
verses.117:18: Chastening, the Lord chastened me, yet He did not deliver me to death.
verses.117:19: Open for me the gates of righteousness; entering through them, I shall give thanks to the Lord.
verses.117:20: This is the gate of the Lord; the righteous shall enter through it.
verses.117:21: I will give thanks to You, for You have heard me and have become salvation to me.
verses.117:22: The stone that the builders rejected, this one has become the head of the corner;
verses.117:23: from the Lord this has come to pass, and it is wondrous in our eyes.
verses.117:24: This is the day which the Lord has made; let us exult and be joyful in it.
verses.117:25: O Lord, save now; O Lord, grant prosperity now.
verses.117:26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord; from the house of the Lord we have blessed you.
verses.117:27: The Lord is God, and He has appeared to us; appoint a feast with thick boughs, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.117:28: You are my God, and I will give thanks to You; You are my God, and I will exalt You; I will give thanks to You, for You have heard me and have become salvation to me.
verses.117:29: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy abides forever.
verses.118:1: Hallelujah. Blessed are the blameless in the way, those who walk in the law of the Lord.
verses.118:2: Blessed are those who search out His testimonies; with a whole heart they seek Him diligently.
verses.118:3: For those who work lawlessness have not walked in His ways.
verses.118:4: You have commanded that Your commandments be kept strictly.
verses.118:5: Oh, that my ways might be directed straight to keep Your ordinances!
verses.118:6: Then I shall by no means be put to shame, when I look upon all Your commandments.
verses.118:7: I will give thanks to You, O Lord, with uprightness of heart, when I have learned the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:8: Your ordinances I will keep; do not forsake me utterly.
verses.118:9: By what means shall a young man set his way straight? By guarding Your words.
verses.118:10: With a whole heart I have sought You diligently; do not thrust me away from Your commandments.
verses.118:11: In my heart I have hidden Your oracles, so that I may not sin against You.
verses.118:12: Blessed are You, O Lord; teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:13: With my lips I have proclaimed all the judgments of Your mouth.
verses.118:14: In the way of Your testimonies I have delighted, as over all wealth.
verses.118:15: I will ponder Your commandments, and I will diligently seek out Your ways.
verses.118:16: In Your ordinances I will meditate; I will not forget Your words.
verses.118:17: Recompense Your servant; I shall live, and I will keep Your words.
verses.118:18: Uncover my eyes, and I will perceive Your wonders out of Your law.
verses.118:19: I am a sojourner in the earth; do not turn Your commandments away from me.
verses.118:20: My soul has yearned to desire Your ordinances at every season.
verses.118:21: You have rebuked the proud; accursed are those who turn aside from Your commandments.
verses.118:22: Take away from me reproach and contempt, for I have diligently sought out Your testimonies.
verses.118:23: For indeed rulers sat and spoke against me, yet Your servant pondered Your ordinances.
verses.118:24: For indeed Your testimonies are my meditation, and Your ordinances are my counsels.
verses.118:25: My soul has clung to the ground; I shall live according to Your oracle.
verses.118:26: Your ways I have declared, and You have heard me; teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:27: And make me understand the way of Your ordinances, and I will ponder Your wonders.
verses.118:28: My soul has grown drowsy from despondency; confirm me in Your words.
verses.118:29: Remove the way of unrighteousness from me, and by Your law have mercy on me.
verses.118:30: The way of truth I have chosen; Your judgments I have not forgotten.
verses.118:31: I have clung to Your testimonies; O Lord, do not put me to shame.
verses.118:32: The way of Your commandments I ran, when You enlarged my heart.
verses.118:33: Set forth as law for me, O Lord, the way of Your ordinances, and I will diligently seek it continually.
verses.118:34: Give me understanding, and I will diligently seek Your law, and I will keep it with my whole heart.
verses.118:35: Guide me in the path of Your commandments, for I have desired it.
verses.118:36: Incline my heart to Your testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.118:37: Turn away my eyes from seeing vanity; in Your way give me life.
verses.118:38: Establish Your servant in Your oracle, for the fear of You.
verses.118:39: Take away my reproach, which I have dreaded, for Your judgments are good.
verses.118:40: Behold, I have desired Your commandments; in Your righteousness give me life.
verses.118:41: And may Your mercy come upon me, O Lord, Your salvation according to Your mercy.
verses.118:42: And I will answer a word to those who reproach me, for I have hoped in Your words.
verses.118:43: And do not take the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for I have set my hope upon Your judgments.
verses.118:44: And I will keep Your law continually, forever and to the age of the age.
verses.118:45: And I walked in a broad place, for I diligently sought out Your commandments.
verses.118:46: And I spoke of Your testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed.
verses.118:47: And I meditated on Your commandments, which You have loved exceedingly.
verses.118:48: And I lifted up my hands toward Your commandments, which You have loved exceedingly, and I pondered Your ordinances.
verses.118:49: Remember Your word concerning Your servants, in which You have caused me to hope.
verses.118:50: This comforted me in my humiliation, for I have not turned aside from Your oracle.
verses.118:51: The proud transgressed the law utterly, yet from Your law I did not turn aside.
verses.118:52: I remembered Your judgments, O Lord, from of old, and I was comforted.
verses.118:53: Despair took hold of me because of sinners who forsake Your law.
verses.118:54: Your ordinances were songs to me in the place of my sojourning.
verses.118:55: I remembered Your name in the night, O Lord, and I kept Your law.
verses.118:56: This became mine; Your ordinances I diligently sought out.
verses.118:57: You are my portion, O Lord; I said that I would keep Your commandments.
verses.118:58: I implored Your face with my whole heart; have mercy on me according to Your oracle.
verses.118:59: For I considered according to Your ways, and I turned my feet back to Your testimonies.
verses.118:60: I prepared myself and was not troubled, to keep Your commandments.
verses.118:61: The cords of sinners entwined around me, and I did not forget Your law.
verses.118:62: At midnight I rose up to give thanks to You for the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:63: I am a companion of all those who fear You and who keep Your commandments.
verses.118:64: All the earth is full of Your mercy, O Lord; teach me Your ordinances, O Lord.
verses.118:65: You have shown goodness to Your servant, O Lord, according to Your oracle.
verses.118:66: Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge, for I have believed in Your commandments.
verses.118:67: Before I was humbled, I erred; therefore I have kept Your oracle.
verses.118:68: You are good, O Lord, and in Your goodness teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:69: The unrighteousness of the proud has been multiplied against me, yet with my whole heart I will search out Your commandments.
verses.118:70: Their heart has curdled like milk, yet I have meditated on Your law.
verses.118:71: It is good for me that You have humbled me, so that I may learn Your ordinances.
verses.118:72: Better for me is the law of Your mouth than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.118:73: Your hands formed me and prepared me; give me understanding, and I will learn Your commandments.
verses.118:74: Those who fear You will see me and rejoice, for I have set my hope upon Your words.
verses.118:75: I know, O Lord, that in righteousness and truth Your judgments have humbled me.
verses.118:76: Now let Your mercy be to comfort me, and Your oracle for Your servant.
verses.118:77: Let Your compassions come to me, and I shall live; for Your law is my meditation.
verses.118:78: Let the proud be put to shame, for unjustly they have acted lawlessly against me; yet I will ponder Your commandments.
verses.118:79: Let those who fear You return, and those who know Your testimonies.
verses.118:80: Let my heart be blameless in Your ordinances, so that I may not be put to shame.
verses.118:81: My soul faints for Your salvation, and I have set my hope upon Your word.
verses.118:82: My eyes have failed for Your oracle, saying, "They have comforted me."
verses.118:83: For I have become like a wineskin in frost; Your ordinances I have not forgotten.
verses.118:84: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment for me upon those who persecute me?
verses.118:85: Lawless men have recounted idle tales to me, yet not like Your law, O Lord.
verses.118:86: All Your commandments are truth; unjustly they have persecuted me; help me.
verses.118:87: They nearly made an end of me on the earth, yet I did not forsake Your commandments.
verses.118:88: According to Your mercy I shall live, and I will keep the testimonies of Your mouth.
verses.118:89: Forever, O Lord, Your word abides in heaven.
verses.118:90: To generation and generation is Your truth; You laid the foundation of the earth, and it abides.
verses.118:91: By Your decree the day abides, for all things are Your servants.
verses.118:92: Were it not that Your law is my meditation, then I would have perished in my humiliation.
verses.118:93: Forever I shall by no means forget Your ordinances, for by them You have given me life, O Lord.
verses.118:94: Yours I am, O Lord; save me, for I have diligently sought out Your ordinances.
verses.118:95: Yet Your testimonies I have understood.
verses.118:96: Of every completion I have seen a limit; Your commandment is exceedingly broad.
verses.118:97: How I have loved Your law, O Lord! All the day long it is my meditation.
verses.118:98: Above my enemies You have made me wise in Your commandments, for they are mine forever.
verses.118:99: Above all those who teach me I have gained understanding, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.118:100: Above the elders I have gained understanding, for I have sought Your commandments.
verses.118:101: From every evil way I have restrained my feet, so that I may keep Your words.
verses.118:102: From Your regions I have not turned aside, for You Yourself have laid down the law for me.
verses.118:103: How sweet to my throat are Your oracles, sweeter than honey and honeycomb to my mouth!
verses.118:104: From Your commandments I have gained understanding; therefore I have hated every way of unrighteousness, for You have laid down the law for me.
verses.118:105: A lamp to my feet is Your law, and a light to my paths.
verses.118:106: I have sworn and confirmed to keep the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:107: I have been humbled utterly; O Lord, give me life according to Your oracle.
verses.118:108: Bless the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me Your judgments.
verses.118:109: My soul is in my hands continually, yet I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.118:110: Sinners have set a snare for me, yet I have not strayed from Your commandments.
verses.118:111: I have inherited Your testimonies forever, for they are the exultation of my heart.
verses.118:112: I have inclined my heart to perform Your ordinances forever, continually as a recompense.
verses.118:113: Lawless men I have hated, and Your law I have loved.
verses.118:114: You are my helper and my protector, and in Your people I have hoped.
verses.118:115: Turn away from me, you evildoers, and I will search out the commandments of my God.
verses.118:116: Come to my aid according to Your oracle and give me life, and do not put me to shame in my expectation.
verses.118:117: Help me, and I shall be saved, and I will meditate on Your ordinances continually.
verses.118:118: You have scorned all those who fall away from Your ordinances, for their intent is unrighteous.
verses.118:119: As transgressors I have reckoned all the sinners of the earth; therefore I have loved Your testimonies continually.
verses.118:120: Nail down my flesh with the fear of You, for I have been afraid of Your judgments.
verses.118:121: I have done judgment and righteousness; do not deliver me over to those who wrong me.
verses.118:122: Receive Your servant for good things; do not let the proud falsely accuse me.
verses.118:123: My eyes have failed for Your salvation, and for the oracle of Your righteousness.
verses.118:124: Deal with Your servant according to Your oracle, and teach me according to Your ordinances.
verses.118:125: I am Your servant; give me understanding, and I will know Your testimonies.
verses.118:126: It is time for the Lord to act; they have shattered Your law.
verses.118:127: Therefore I have loved Your commandments above gold and topaz.
verses.118:128: Therefore I kept myself straight toward all Your commandments; every unrighteous way I have hated.
verses.118:129: Wondrous are Your testimonies; therefore my soul has searched them out.
verses.118:130: The manifestation of Your words will give light, and will give understanding to infants.
verses.118:131: I opened my mouth and drew in breath, for I yearned for Your commandments.
verses.118:132: Look upon me and have mercy on me, according to the judgment of those who love Your name.
verses.118:133: Direct my steps straight according to Your oracle, and do not let any lawlessness have dominion over me.
verses.118:134: Redeem me from the false accusation of men, and I will keep Your commandments.
verses.118:135: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:136: My eyes poured down streams of waters, because they did not keep Your law.
verses.118:137: Righteous are You, O Lord, and upright is Your judgment.
verses.118:138: You have commanded Your testimonies as righteousness, and truth exceedingly.
verses.118:139: Zeal for Your house has melted me away, because my enemies have forgotten Your commandments.
verses.118:140: Your oracle has been tried by fire exceedingly, and Your servant has loved it.
verses.118:141: I am young and scorned; Your ordinances I have not forgotten.
verses.118:142: Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and Your word is truth.
verses.118:143: Tribulations and distress have found me; Your commandments are my meditation.
verses.118:144: Your testimonies are righteousness forever; give me understanding, and give me life.
verses.118:145: I have cried out with a whole heart; hear me, O Lord; Your ordinances I will diligently seek out.
verses.118:146: I have cried out to You; save me, and I will keep Your testimonies.
verses.118:147: They came upon me in the untimely hour, and I cried out; upon Your words I have set my hope.
verses.118:148: My eyes anticipated rising early toward You, to meditate on Your oracles.
verses.118:149: Hear my voice, O Lord, according to Your oracle; according to Your judgment give me life.
verses.118:150: Those who persecute me with lawlessness have drawn near, yet from Your law they have gone far away.
verses.118:151: You are near, O Lord, and all Your ways are truth.
verses.118:152: From the beginning I have known from Your testimonies that You have founded them forever.
verses.118:153: Look upon my humiliation and deliver me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.118:154: Judge my cause and redeem me; for the sake of Your word give me life.
verses.118:155: Salvation is far from sinners, for they have not diligently sought out Your ordinances.
verses.118:156: Your compassions are exceedingly many, O Lord; according to Your judgments give me life.
verses.118:157: Many are those who persecute me and afflict me; from Your testimonies I have not turned aside.
verses.118:158: I beheld those who act treacherously and melted away, because they did not keep Your oracles.
verses.118:159: See that I have loved Your commandments, O Lord; in Your mercy give me life.
verses.118:160: The beginning of Your words is truth, and all the judgments of Your righteousness are forever.
verses.118:161: Rulers have persecuted me without cause, yet at Your words my heart has trembled with fear.
verses.118:162: I will exult over Your oracles, as one who finds abundant spoil.
verses.118:163: Unrighteousness I have hated and abhorred, but Your law I have loved.
verses.118:164: Seven times a day I have praised You for the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:165: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law, and there is no stumbling block for them.
verses.118:166: I have waited for Your salvation, O Lord, and Your commandments I have loved.
verses.118:167: And my soul has kept Your testimonies, and has loved them exceedingly.
verses.118:168: I have kept Your commandments and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
verses.118:169: Now let my supplication draw near before You, O Lord, O Lord; according to Your oracle give me understanding.
verses.118:170: May my petition enter before You; according to Your oracle deliver me.
verses.118:171: My lips have poured forth a hymn whenever You teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:172: May my tongue utter Your oracle, for all Your commandments are righteousness.
verses.118:173: Let Your hand be ready to save, for I have chosen Your commandments.
verses.118:174: I have yearned for Your salvation, O Lord, and Your law is my meditation.
verses.118:175: My soul shall live and shall praise You, and Your judgments shall help me.
verses.118:176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; give life to Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
verses.119:1: A Song of the Ascents. To the Lord I cried out in my affliction, and He heard me.
verses.119:2: O Lord, deliver my soul from unjust lips and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.119:3: What shall be given to you, and what shall be added to you, against a deceitful tongue?
verses.119:4: The arrows of the mighty one, sharpened, together with the coals of the wilderness.
verses.119:5: Woe to me, for my sojourning has been prolonged; I have encamped among the tents of Kedar.
verses.119:6: My soul has long sojourned with those who hate peace.
verses.119:7: I was peaceable; whenever I spoke to them, they made war against me without cause.
verses.120:1: A Song of the Ascents. I lifted up my eyes to the mountains; from where shall my help come?
verses.120:2: My help is from the Lord, who made the heaven and the earth.
verses.120:3: Do not give your foot to slipping, nor shall He who guards you slumber.
verses.120:4: Behold, He who guards Israel shall neither slumber nor fall fast asleep.
verses.120:5: The Lord shall guard you; the Lord is your shelter upon your right hand;
verses.120:6: by day the sun shall not scorch you, nor the moon by night.
verses.120:7: The Lord shall guard you from all evil; may He guard your soul.
verses.120:8: The Lord shall guard your coming in and your going out from now and forevermore.
verses.121:1: A Song of the Ascents. Of David. I rejoiced at those who said to me, "We shall go into the house of the Lord."
verses.121:2: Our feet were standing in the courts of Jerusalem.
verses.121:3: Jerusalem is built as a city whose fellowship is together as one.
verses.121:4: For there the tribes of the Lord went up, a testimony of Israel, to give thanks to the name of the Lord;
verses.121:5: for there thrones sat for judgment, thrones over the house of David,
verses.121:6: and prosperity for those who love you; ask now for the things pertaining to peace for Jerusalem.
verses.121:7: May your peace indeed be in your strength, and prosperity in your fortified towers,
verses.121:8: for the sake of my brethren and my neighbors. And I spoke peace concerning you;
verses.121:9: for the sake of the house of the Lord our God I sought it out for you.
verses.122:1: A Song of Ascents. To You I have lifted up my eyes, O You who dwell in heaven.
verses.122:2: Behold, as the eyes of servants are toward the hands of their masters, as the eyes of a maidservant are toward the hands of her mistress, so our eyes are toward the Lord our God, until He has compassion on us.
verses.122:3: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we have been abundantly filled with contempt.
verses.122:4: Our soul has been filled all the more—reproach to those who prosper, and contempt to the proud.
verses.123:1: A Song of Ascents. "Had it not been that the Lord was among us," let Israel now say—
verses.123:2: "Had it not been that the Lord was among us when men rose up against us,
verses.123:3: then they would have swallowed us alive when their wrath raged against us;
verses.123:4: then the water would have drowned us; our soul would have passed through a torrent;
verses.123:5: then our soul would have passed through the irresistible water."
verses.123:6: Blessed be the Lord, who did not give us for prey to their teeth.
verses.123:7: Our soul was delivered like a sparrow from the snare of the hunters; the snare was shattered, and we were delivered.
verses.123:8: Our help is in the name of the Lord, the One who made heaven and earth.
verses.124:1: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion; he who dwells in Jerusalem shall never be shaken.
verses.124:2: Mountains are around her, and the Lord is around His people, from now on and forevermore.
verses.124:3: For He will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the righteous, lest the righteous stretch out their hands in iniquity.
verses.124:4: Do good, O Lord, to the good, and to the upright in heart.
verses.124:5: But those who turn aside into crooked ways the Lord will lead away with those who work iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.125:1: A Song of Ascents. When the Lord turned back the captivity of Zion, we became like those who have been comforted.
verses.125:2: Then our mouth was filled with joy, and our tongue with exultation; then they shall say among the nations, "The Lord has done great deeds with them."
verses.125:3: The Lord has done great deeds with us; we became glad.
verses.125:4: Turn back our captivity, O Lord, like the torrent in the south.
verses.125:5: Those who sow in tears shall reap in exultation.
verses.125:6: Going forth, they went on and wept, bearing their seeds; yet coming, they shall indeed come in exultation, bearing their sheaves.
verses.126:1: A Song of Ascents. Unless the Lord builds a house, those who build it toil in vain; unless the Lord guards a city, the watchman keeps vigil in vain.
verses.126:2: It is in vain for you to rise early, to rise up after sitting down, you who eat the bread of sorrow, when He gives sleep to His beloved ones.
verses.126:3: Behold, the heritage of the Lord is sons, the reward of the fruit of her womb.
verses.126:4: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the sons of those who have been shaken out.
verses.126:5: Blessed is he who shall fulfill his desire from them; he shall not be put to shame when they speak to their enemies in the gate.
